title: Beyond Expected Return: Accounting for Policy Reproducibility when Evaluating Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
venue: AAAI
one_liner: 用带偏好的下置信界(LCB)替代期望回报评估RL策略 → 同时反映回报均值与离散度,可区分均值同但稳定性异的策略
ai_mechanism: RL策略评估:多次roll-out回报视为分布,用mean−λ·spread的LCB排序,λ可调性能-稳定性偏好
target_quantity: 策略回报分布特征(期望+离散度)及LCB排序分
has_classical_optimum: no — 评估准则选择,非估计
incumbent_beaten: 仅用期望回报的标准RL评估
novelty_angle: 把RL评估从'估期望回报'重构为'刻画回报分布并暴露性能-可复现权衡'
data_used: 通用不确定性RL基准(非金融);findata不适用
why_accepted: 指出期望回报在不确定环境下比较的根本不足并给可操作LCB指标

title: IKNet: Interpretable Stock Price Prediction via Keyword-Guided Integration of News and Technical Indicators
venue: ICAIF
one_liner: FinBERT选词+每词独立投影+GRU/Bi-LSTM融合新闻关键词与技术指标+SHAP逐词归因 → 次日收盘价RMSE降最多32.9%且可解释
ai_mechanism: 显著性关键词抽取+每关键词独立非线性投影(防表征混合)+GRU文本/Bi-LSTM指标+Kernel SHAP逐token方向归因
target_quantity: 次日S&P500收盘价(回归)+逐关键词SHAP贡献
incumbent_beaten: Ridge/LSTM/Transformer/TCN/FinBERT-Attention-LSTM/FinBERT-Sentiment-LSTM
novelty_angle: 每词一投影通道保token可分性,使SHAP给干净逐词归因
data_used: S&P500 OHLCV+17技术指标+Google News~2500篇(2015-24);findata-native(price+text)
why_accepted: 同时具强预测精度与关键词级可量化解释,补XAI仅高层相关之缺

title: Vision, Voice, and Text: Pioneering Zero-shot Multimodal LLMs for Sentiment-driven Investment
venue: ICAIF
one_liner: 零样本多模态LLM整合文本+音频+视频提情绪+自洽验证+JSON → 多资产收益(声称VIX年化2843.9%),全模态优于text-only
ai_mechanism: 零样本多模态LLM(text+audio+video)情绪打分+自洽信号验证+结构化JSON接交易
target_quantity: 多模态情绪推出的交易信号及投资收益
incumbent_beaten: text-only与text-audio情感基线
novelty_angle: 首个把语音+视觉副语言线索经零样本MLLM引入金融情感投资+开源WHPB基准
data_used: 自建WHPB(30场白宫发布会视频+资产价格含VIX);需video/audio非findata原生,VIX不可直接交易,微样本极端收益存疑
why_accepted: 开创多模态零样本LLM金融情感投资+贡献公开多模态基准

title: Disentangling Long-Short Term State Under Unknown Interventions for Online Time Series Forecasting
venue: AAAI
one_liner: 把非平稳重定义为对短期潜变量的未知干预,用干预不连续性建块级可识别性定理解耦长/短期状态 → 在线预测MSE降,汇率-44%
ai_mechanism: 变分序列自编码器+长/短期潜状态先验+干预驱动非线性ICA块级可识别性理论;平滑约束保长依赖,L1中断依赖约束强制干预点遗忘并检测干预
target_quantity: 解耦的长/短期潜状态及其重构预测的未来观测
incumbent_beaten: OneNet/FSNet/OneNet-TCN/DER++/ER/MIR/TFCL/Online-TCN/Informer
novelty_angle: 把'未知干预打断短期依赖'形式化为长短期块级可识别性定理(理论+汇率真数据44%)
data_used: ETT/Weather/ECL/Traffic/Exchange;金融部分(Exchange日频汇率)findata-native(price-like)
why_accepted: 首个在未知干预非平稳下对长/短期潜变量给块级可识别性保证的在线预测

title: Physics-Informed Koopman Neural Estimation of the Heston Model from High-Frequency Observations
venue: AAAI
one_liner: SDE生成元约束的神经Koopman算子+ART-filter波动率估计+矩初始化 → 最少假设下稳健恢复Heston五参数
ai_mechanism: PINN:神经Koopman算子线性化随机动力学+以SDE无穷小生成元作硬约束loss+前置非参波动率滤波与矩初始化
target_quantity: Heston随机波动率模型5参数(κ/θ/ξ/ρ/v0)
incumbent_beaten: 现有Heston估计器(矩法/MLE/特征函数/滤波)
novelty_angle: Koopman+PINN生成元约束注入金融标定,最少假设稳健恢复全部五参数
data_used: 高频价格;需intraday/高频+期权语境,非findata-native
why_accepted: 桥接Koopman与神经建模处理部分可观测耦合随机动力学,跨状态一致稳健五参数恢复

title: Times2D: Multi-Period Decomposition and Derivative Mapping for General Time Series Forecasting
venue: AAAI
one_liner: 频域多周期分解把1D序列变2D张量+一/二阶导数热图+2D卷积 → 通用时序短/长期预测SOTA
ai_mechanism: 周期分解块(频域1D→2D)+一/二阶导数热图(捕拐点)+聚合预测块,2D卷积刻画长短期
target_quantity: 未来时序点值(短/长期)
incumbent_beaten: 主流通用时序预测器(TimesNet/PatchTST/DLinear/iTransformer等)
novelty_angle: 在周期-2D变换上加显式导数热图通道专捕尖峰拐点
data_used: 多领域时序基准(能源/交通/金融/气象/医疗);金融仅应用之一,none-generic
why_accepted: 1D→2D周期分解+导数映射通用表征短长期均SOTA

title: Bidirectional Looking with A Novel Double Exponential Moving Average to Adaptive and Non-adaptive Momentum Optimizers
venue: ICML
one_liner: 把股市去滞后指标DEMA+动态lookahead塞进动量优化器 → 多任务更快更好收敛
ai_mechanism: 动量优化器:双指数移动平均做去滞后梯度回看+随训练衰减的前瞻步长,挂RAdam与SGDM两主干,附收敛证明
target_quantity: 神经网络训练收敛速度与最终泛化精度
has_classical_optimum: no — 非凸优化无最优器
incumbent_beaten: SGDM/RAdam/Lookahead类
novelty_angle: 把金融技术指标DEMA去滞后机制迁移为动量估计,统一backward/forward-looking
data_used: 通用DL任务(NLP/视觉);金融仅灵感来源,findata不适用
why_accepted: 统一回看/前瞻的通用动量框架跨自适应/非自适应均提升+收敛证明

title: Focal-SAM: Focal Sharpness-Aware Minimization for Long-Tailed Classification
venue: ICML
one_liner: 给类级sharpness惩罚乘focal权重(1−π)^γ替代逐类扰动 → 长尾分类细粒度平坦化+仅3次反传+更紧1/n泛化界
ai_mechanism: SAM变体:逐类扰动半径换成对class-wise sharpness的focal加权(head→tail递增),一阶Taylor近似内层极大,更新仅3次反传,附PAC-Bayes界
target_quantity: 长尾分类balanced accuracy及head/medium/tail各组泛化(含OOD)
incumbent_beaten: SAM/ImbSAM/CC-SAM(及CE/LA/VS损失)
novelty_angle: Hessian谱诊断揭示ImbSAM让head变尖/CC-SAM太贵的失败模式,再用focal加权兼顾控制与效率
data_used: CIFAR-LT/ImageNet-LT/iNaturalist/CLIP+OOD;纯视觉长尾,非findata-native
why_accepted: 保效率同时细粒度控loss landscape并给比SAM/CC-SAM更紧泛化界

title: ParFam - (Neural Guided) Symbolic Regression via Continuous Global Optimization
venue: ICLR
one_liner: 用参数化函数族把离散符号回归连续化+全局优化(+预训练transformer引导) → SRBench SOTA且提速最多100×
ai_mechanism: 符号回归:以表达力够的参数化符号函数族(系数连续)把离散表达式搜索重述为连续全局优化,DL-ParFam用预训练transformer作结构先验引导
target_quantity: 从数据恢复的确定性符号表达式/控制方程
has_classical_optimum: partial — 给定族内全局可解
incumbent_beaten: 基于遗传编程的SR方法(SRBench SOTA)
novelty_angle: 把离散符号搜索转成固定参数族上连续全局优化+神经引导提速两数量级
data_used: SRBench合成/科学方程;金融仅潜在应用,无金融实验,非findata-native
why_accepted: 带表达力理论分析、SRBench SOTA且可神经引导大幅加速的连续化符号回归

title: A Fast Non-Linear Coupled Tensor Completion Algorithm for Financial Data Integration and Imputation
venue: ICAIF
one_liner: 正交正则的非线性耦合张量补全重构稀疏金融张量 → 比线性法降40-74%、比非线性SOTA降2-52%
ai_mechanism: per-mode embedding+MLP 非线性张量交互+正交正则抗稀疏过拟合,支持耦合分解做数据融合
target_quantity: 缺失张量格子重构值(债券特征/EPS面板填补)
has_classical_optimum: partial — 线性低秩补全有基线,非线性稀疏无最优
incumbent_beaten: 线性张量补全(CP/Tucker)与SOTA非线性张量补全
novelty_angle: 正交正则专治稀疏张量大秩过拟合+低成本+原生耦合
data_used: 债券特征/分析师EPS面板;findata-native
why_accepted: 真实稀疏金融张量上对线性与非线性SOTA同时大幅提升且低成本

title: FISHNET: Financial Intelligence from Sub-querying, Harmonizing, Neural-Conditioning, Expert Swarms, and Task Planning
venue: ICAIF
one_liner: agentic架构(子查询+任务规划+harmonizer+expert-swarm)跨6类9.8万SEC申报做复合查询 → 成功率61.8% vs RAG 5.0%
ai_mechanism: 幻觉评估+查询改写拆子查询;ICL任务规划;每类申报一专家检索agent(分层FAISS);中央harmonizer做跨表算术与跨期口径调和
target_quantity: 跨文件复合查询的可执行准确答案(检索R-Precision/路由准确率/agentic成功率)
incumbent_beaten: 纯RAG(5.0%)/Generative Routing(55.7%)/金融微调LLM
novelty_angle: 把Agent-Based-Modeling从市场模拟重定位为数据库情报生成,融合中央编排+去中心swarm
data_used: 98034份SEC申报(EDGAR+IAPD);需EDGAR/IAPD抓取+restatement-vintage调和,非findata原生
why_accepted: 严格消融证每个agent必要,端到端成功率较基线量级提升

title: Transformers and Attention-based Networks in Quantitative Trading: A Comprehensive Survey
venue: ICAIF
one_liner: 综述attention/Transformer在量化交易应用 → 按Alpha/Risk/Portfolio/Execution四象限分类
ai_mechanism: attention/Transformer架构家族(综述对象)
target_quantity: 无(分类法+挑战清单)
has_classical_optimum: partial — 各下游环节有经典最优
incumbent_beaten: 无(综述)
novelty_angle: 首个按交易流水线四环节组织attention量化应用的系统综述
data_used: 无原始数据(被引文献跨股/汇/币/期)
why_accepted: 提供领域地图与分类法,识别拥挤区与开放机会

title: Chimera: Effectively Modeling Multivariate Time Series with 2-Dimensional State Space Models
venue: NeurIPS
one_liner: 选择性SSM从1D推广到2D(时间×变量双轴) → 多变量时序分类/预测/异常检测以线性复杂度超Transformer/Mamba
ai_mechanism: 二维SSM:状态是(时间,变量)网格函数,时间轴companion矩阵捕自回归季节性,变量轴对角门控,参数输入相关选择性过滤;2D并行prefix-sum扫描保线性
target_quantity: 多变量时序下一/多步预测值与序列类别
incumbent_beaten: iTransformer/PatchTST/Crossformer/TimesNet/DLinear/Mamba(Simba,TSM2)/SpaceTime/S4
novelty_angle: 首个时间与变量两轴同时selectivity的2D SSM,可证恢复SARIMA/ETS又线性复杂度
data_used: ETT/ECL/Exchange/Traffic/Weather/M4/ECG/语音/UEA/异常检测;金融仅Exchange,多数非金融
why_accepted: 可证表达力强且训练线性的2D选择性SSM跨域多变量任务全面达/超SOTA且省算力

title: Debiasing Conditional Stochastic Optimization
venue: NeurIPS
one_liner: 对嵌套期望梯度施加随机外推(仿射组合)去偏 → CSO/FCCO非凸样本复杂度O(ε^-6/-5)降到O(ε^-4.5/-3.5)
ai_mechanism: 随机外推去偏算子(Richardson/控制变量):内层条件期望多小batch估计做仿射组合抵消Taylor低阶项把偏差O(m^-1)降到O(m^-k),再配SpiderBoost方差缩减
target_quantity: 条件随机优化目标的ε-稳定点
incumbent_beaten: BSGD/BSpiderBoost/RT-MLMC/MSVR-V2
novelty_angle: 通用外推去偏把'嵌套期望偏差'从大batch硬扛改为廉价代数消除,改进样本复杂度上界
data_used: 合成IRM logistic数据;portfolio仅动机性,无真实金融数据,非findata-native
why_accepted: 提出通用随机外推去偏并对CSO/FCCO给严格优于现有界的样本复杂度证明

title: TaskMet: Task-Driven Metric Learning for Model Learning
venue: NeurIPS
one_liner: 把任务损失下沉去学预测空间的度量(损失几何)而非模型参数 → 不改最优预测器前提下提升组合优化/预算/含噪RL下游决策
ai_mechanism: 双层优化:外层用下游任务损失学预测空间马氏度量,内层用该度量化损失训练预测模型,各向异性加权预测误差且保贝叶斯最优解不变
target_quantity: 下游决策表现(组合收益/预算/RL回报),经学到的metric加权预测损失间接优化
incumbent_beaten: 端到端决策聚焦学习与predict-then-optimize基线
novelty_angle: 把决策聚焦干预层级从'改模型参数'下沉到'改训练度量',解耦预测质量与决策适配
data_used: 组合优化/预算分配/含分心RL;portfolio部分可findata-native
why_accepted: 在预测空间学度量,不损预测最优性同时改善决策聚焦下游

title: AlphaForge: A Framework to Mine and Dynamically Combine Formulaic Alpha Factors
venue: AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
one_liner: 干预X=生成-预测网络挖因子+按时序表现动态选权重组合 → 指标Y=横截面IC/RankIC与组合超额收益
ai_mechanism: generative-predictive surrogate network (gradient-maximizes a learned fitness predictor, gumbel-softmax onehot formula sampling, diversity penalty) + per-day re-ranked linear combination of factor zoo
target_quantity: cross-sectional next-period stock return (formulaic alpha factor value → return rank)
incumbent_beaten: RL-synergistic alpha mining (Yu et al. 2023), GP, DSO symbolic regression, XGB/LightGBM/MLP on CSI300/CSI500
novelty_angle: decouples mining from combination and adds factor-timing (dynamic weights track momentum of factor performance), beating fixed-weight RL incumbent; 'mine as much as you use'
data_used: findata-native (CSI300/CSI500 OHLCV+vwap via Qlib; price-only)
why_accepted: beats SOTA RL alpha miner on IC/RankIC across two indices plus real-money trading (21.68% excess vs CSI500), interpretable formulas, ablation isolates dynamic combination

title: FinVision: A Multi-Agent Framework for Stock Market Prediction
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 干预X=多模态多智能体LLM(新闻摘要+candlestick视觉分析+视觉反思模块)做日频交易决策 → 指标Y=ARR/Sharpe/MDD
ai_mechanism: LangGraph-orchestrated specialized LLM agents (summarizer, vision technical analyst, dual reflection on past trade signals, decision agent with position sizing) with self-reflective memory loop
target_quantity: daily trading action (BUY/SELL/HOLD) + position size as % of portfolio
incumbent_beaten: buy-and-hold, MACD, KDJ+RSI, PPO, DQN (but underperforms FinAgent)
novelty_angle: adds visual reflection module + dynamic position sizing under 2-month training (vs FinAgent 1-year), cutting API cost; ablation shows reflection module drives gains
data_used: needs intraday/charts + news (AAPL/AMZN/MSFT candlestick images, Yahoo news) — only 3 tickers, 7-month bull test
why_accepted: beats rule-based and RL baselines on risk-adjusted metrics with cheaper training, transparent CoT decision traces, reflection ablation

title: Federated Learning from Vision-Language Foundation Models: Theoretical Analysis and Method
venue: Neural Information Processing Systems
one_liner: 干预X=用feature-learning理论把任务相关/无关系数类比Markowitz收益/风险,混合global+local prompt成'prompt portfolio' → 指标Y=联邦CLIP分类准确率与最优混合系数
ai_mechanism: feature-learning-theory two-stage coefficient dynamics analysis of signal-learning vs noise-memorization; portfolio-optimization analogy yields convex mixing of two prompt 'assets' with closed-form optimal coefficient
target_quantity: test error of prompt-based federated CLIP (ratio of task-relevant to task-irrelevant coefficients)
incumbent_beaten: CoOp, PromptFL, pFedPrompt/FedOTP variants, FedTPG on CIFAR-100/DomainNet/Office/OxfordPets/DTD
novelty_angle: borrows Markowitz two-asset risk-reduction as the mechanism to derive provably-better and optimally-mixed federated prompts; finance theory exported INTO ML (reverse direction)
data_used: non-finance (vision FL benchmarks); finance enters only as Markowitz analogy
why_accepted: first feature-learning-theory framework for federated prompt learning with proven advantage + closed-form optimal coefficient, empirically validated across datasets/heterogeneity/client-counts

title: FinQAPT: End-to-End LLM-driven Question Answering Pipeline
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 干预X=三模块RAG管线(query分解+TF-IDF页检索+聚类负采样微调检索器+Dynamic N-shot CoT) → 指标Y=FinQA数值推理准确率/Recall@N
ai_mechanism: retrieval-augmented generation pipeline: query decomposition, sparse page retrieval, clustering-based hard-negative sampling for dense reranker, dynamic semantically-retrieved few-shot CoT prompting
target_quantity: numerical-reasoning answer accuracy over financial reports (FinQA), retrieval recall
incumbent_beaten: APOLLO (71%), GPT-4 CoT (78%); FinReader module reaches 80.6% SOTA
novelty_angle: clustering-based negative sampling (dense+sparse) + Dynamic N-shot prompting; honestly reports module-SOTA but end-to-end degradation from dispersed multi-page context (negative-result transparency)
data_used: needs restatement-style filings (FinQA + S&P500 10-K/10-Q earnings reports, table+text)
why_accepted: module-level SOTA on FinQA plus rigorous error analysis exposing where end-to-end financial-context integration fails

title: From GARCH to Neural Network for Volatility Forecast
venue: AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
one_liner: 干预X=建立GARCH族与NN的结构等价并将其作模块嵌入LSTM(GARCH-LSTM)注入波动率stylized facts → 指标Y=波动率MSE/MAE与VaR违例率
ai_mechanism: proves GARCH(1,1)≡truncated RNN, GJR-GARCH≡signed-input RNN, FI-GARCH≡1D-CNN; plugs GARCH NN-cell as LSTM output gate with maximum-likelihood (Student-t) loss
target_quantity: h-step-ahead realized volatility / variance of asset log-returns
incumbent_beaten: vanilla GARCH(1,1)/GJR/FI-GARCH, Autoformer/Informer/Reformer/Transformer on 5 global assets
novelty_angle: first explicit structural equivalence between GARCH family and NN primitives, infusing stylized facts (clustering/asymmetry/long-memory) into NN structure rather than as input features; t-likelihood loss beats MSE
data_used: findata-native (S&P500/DJI/NASDAQ/EUR-USD/Gold daily close from Yahoo; price-only)
why_accepted: novel GARCH↔NN equivalence (validated on simulation params), MLE loss superiority, GARCH-LSTM beats both econometric and transformer SOTA on most horizons with VaR application

title: AI in Investment Analysis: LLMs for Equity Stock Ratings
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 干预X=零样本GPT-4(训练截止前)按不同数据模态(基本面/新闻/情绪)生成股票评级 → 指标Y=按forward-return分位评估的MAE
ai_mechanism: zero/few-shot CoT prompting of a leakage-controlled LLM as financial-analyst persona with ablated data modalities (vanilla returns / news summary / sentiment score / fundamentals), chain-of-verification on dates
target_quantity: ordinal equity rating (-2..2) evaluated against forward-return quintiles, multi-horizon
incumbent_beaten: real Wall-Street analyst ratings (MAE 1.57 vs Vanilla 1.45, Fundamentals 1.42)
novelty_angle: audits which modalities help/hurt LLM ratings: fundamentals best, news data INDUCES positive bias and degrades accuracy; sentiment scores match summaries at lower token cost; rigorous training-cutoff leakage control
data_used: findata-native but multimodal (S&P500 fundamentals 10-Q/10-K via SEC, returns, news/sentiment; PIT leakage controlled)
why_accepted: novel under-explored LLM rating task with leakage-aware design; LLM beats analysts on forward returns; finding that news adds bias is the audit insight

title: A Financial Time Series Denoiser Based on Diffusion Models
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 干预X=条件diffusion(SDE)做有限步noising-denoising并以self-condition+TV/Fourier guidance净化价格序列 → 指标Y=下游收益分类F1/MCC与交易收益/交易次数
ai_mechanism: conditional score-based diffusion (VE/VP-SDE, CSDI transformer backbone) with self-conditioning c=x0, classifier-free guidance, Total-Variation + Fourier inference guidance, multi-seed averaging; noising-denoising purification
target_quantity: denoised price series → future log-return sign classification and tradable signal quality
incumbent_beaten: EMA, Denoising AutoEncoder (DAE) on 1day/1hour/5min S&P500
novelty_angle: diffusion-as-denoiser ('interior smoothing + exterior sharpening' of return distribution) raises downstream SNR; noisy-vs-clean trend classifier yields regime-aware counter/follow-trend strategy
data_used: findata-native + intraday (S&P500 daily/hourly/5min close from Stooq; price-only)
why_accepted: novel CV-purification import to finance with theory-grounded SDE framing, consistent F1/MCC gains over DAE/EMA, profitable lower-turnover trading and regime-detection application

title: Quantile Regression using Random Forest Proximities
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 干预X=用RF-GAP proximity作实例级权重估计条件分布替代传统QRF叶节点权重 → 指标Y=quantile loss/预测区间宽度/覆盖率
ai_mechanism: instance-weighted conditional CDF estimation using RF-GAP (geometry-and-accuracy-preserving) random-forest proximities as adaptive kNN weights, vs leaf-co-occurrence QRF weights
target_quantity: full conditional distribution / prediction intervals of corporate-bond average daily trade volume (liquidity, time-to-liquidation)
incumbent_beaten: Meinshausen QRF, original RF proximity, OOB proximity on toy datasets + TRACE bonds
novelty_angle: replaces equal-weight leaf proximities with in/out-of-bag-corrected RF-GAP proximities for tighter, better-calibrated quantiles at single-model cost; applied to bond liquidity-risk/ADV forecasting
data_used: needs non-standard data (MarketAxess TRACE corporate-bond trades + bond features; not equity-price-native) plus UCI toy sets
why_accepted: RF-GAP gives lowest quantile loss and narrowest intervals across datasets/quantiles with computational efficiency and a regulatory-relevant liquidity application

title: Optimizing Large Language Models for ESG Activity Detection in Financial Texts
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 微调小型开源LLM(+合成数据增强)→ NFD文本到EU ESG活动分类的weighted-F1
ai_mechanism: LoRA fine-tuning of decoder LLMs on original+synthetic-augmented labeled text for binary text-to-taxonomy classification
target_quantity: binary label: does text chunk c pertain to ESG taxonomy activity i
incumbent_beaten: zero-shot LLMs, GPT-4o-mini, encoder-only ESG-BERT / FinBERT
novelty_angle: first benchmark mapping disclosure text to granular EU ESG-taxonomy activities; synthetic augmentation lets 7B open models beat proprietary
data_used: 1,325 labeled NFD text segments from 4 transport firms (Maersk etc.); text-only, findata-native if text channel used; not price data
why_accepted: new labeled ESG-activities benchmark + evidence small fine-tuned open models can surpass proprietary LLMs

title: LOB-Bench: Benchmarking Generative AI for Finance — an Application to Limit Order Book Data
venue: International Conference on Machine Learning
one_liner: 用条件/无条件分布距离+判别器+冲击响应评测生成式LOB模型 → 揭示autoregressive trap与model derailment
ai_mechanism: distributional evaluation framework: aggregator/scoring functions reducing high-dim message sequences to 1d, compared via L1/Wasserstein, plus adversarial discriminator and price-impact response functions
target_quantity: realism/quality of generated message-by-order LOB data vs ground truth distributions
has_classical_optimum: partial (Almgren-Chriss impact; parametric Cont model baseline)
incumbent_beaten: Cont et al. parametric LOB baseline, Coletta CGAN, RWKV; autoregressive S5 (LOBS5) wins
novelty_angle: first fully distributional LOB benchmark; exposes cross-entropy insufficiency and error-accumulation failure mode in open-loop sampling
data_used: LOBSTER message-level data for GOOG/INTC (NASDAQ); needs intraday/microstructure data, not findata-native
why_accepted: rigorous quantitative benchmark replacing qualitative stylized-facts; discriminator sets high bar; identifies common derailment failure

title: Structured Agentic Workflows for Financial Time-Series Modeling with LLMs and Reflective Feedback
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 带知识库+反思反馈的多阶段LLM agent(TS-Agent)→ 金融时序预测/生成的精度、风险指标差、成功率与可审计性
ai_mechanism: modular planner agent with case-bank/code-base/refinement knowledge banks, case-based reasoning + reflective feedback loop (chain-of-code-edits) over model-selection/refinement/fine-tuning
target_quantity: forecast accuracy (RMSE/MAE/MAPE), generation fidelity (marginal/correlation/VaR/ES), and trading-risk metric gaps
incumbent_beaten: AutoGluon, Optuna (AutoML); DS-Agent, ResearchAgent (LLM agents)
novelty_angle: domain-knowledge-banked, auditable agent that refines existing models rather than coding from scratch → backbone-agnostic robustness + 100% success rate
data_used: Crypto hourly, Exchange daily FX, US Stock daily; mostly findata-native price series
why_accepted: consistent SOTA over AutoML and agent baselines with added interpretability/auditability for regulated finance

title: Nested Expectations with Kernel Quadrature
venue: International Conference on Machine Learning
one_liner: 用嵌套核求积(NKQ)替代nested-MC估计嵌套期望 → 平滑被积函数下更快收敛率/更少样本(含期权风险损失估计)
ai_mechanism: two-stage nested kernel quadrature (RKHS/Sobolev kernel ridge regression) replacing inner+outer Monte Carlo estimators
target_quantity: nested expectation E[f(E[g(X,θ)])] e.g. expected option loss under shock
has_classical_optimum: yes (Black-Scholes option pricing, nested MC/MLMC baselines)
incumbent_beaten: nested Monte Carlo, nested QMC, multilevel Monte Carlo
novelty_angle: only method exploiting smoothness of f,g to beat O(∆^-2) of MLMC; provable faster rate + sub-exponential tail bound
data_used: synthetic; Black-Scholes butterfly-option expected-loss + health economics + Bayesian opt; analytic, no real market data
why_accepted: novel estimator with proven faster convergence rate and empirical sample-efficiency on option pricing / risk management

title: FinResearchBench: A Logic Tree based Agent-as-a-Judge Evaluation Framework for Financial Research Agents
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 从研究报告抽取逻辑树作为中间表示的Agent-as-a-Judge → 自动评测金融深度研究agent(7类任务,vs人类专家)
ai_mechanism: logic-tree extraction (argument/evidence nodes) via prompted LLM + rule-derived structural metrics (width/depth/info-density) and LLM-judged qualitative dimensions
target_quantity: quality score of financial research reports across width/depth/coherence/professionalism dimensions
incumbent_beaten: direct LLM-as-a-Judge / general benchmarks (HelloBench, DeepResearch Bench); Gemini/OpenAI/Cashcat agents ranked, human still tops
novelty_angle: first logic-tree-based Agent-as-a-Judge for finance; intermediate logic tree gives interpretable rule-based metrics; 70 finance questions across 7 task types
data_used: 70 curated finance research questions from real product queries + 20 expert reports; text/research-output, findata-native
why_accepted: first finance-dedicated deep-research-agent evaluation framework with logic-tree intermediate representation; validates extraction accuracy

title: Tracing Positional Bias in Financial Decision-Making: Mechanistic Insights from Qwen2.5
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 在金融二元配对决策中检测并机制定位LLM位置偏差 → 量化primacy/recency并溯源到具体层/注意力头
ai_mechanism: positional-bias detection (Wilcoxon/Hodges-Lehmann effect sizes) + mechanistic interpretability (Direct Logit Attribution, logit-lens ranking, attention-head ablation) on Qwen2.5 1.5B-14B
target_quantity: positional preference (Δ probability) in ticker pairwise choice; layer/head attribution of bias
incumbent_beaten: prior general-purpose positional-bias studies (no finance, no mechanistic trace)
novelty_angle: first unified benchmark + mechanistic localization of positional bias in finance LLM decisions; identifies universal mid-late-layer 'bias engine' heads, Risk category resists scaling
data_used: 73,440 synthetic finance prompts over 18 FAANG+ large-cap tickers, 10 categories x 2 orderings x 4 styles; prompt/ticker-only, findata-native
why_accepted: bridges domain-specific bias audit with mechanistic interpretability; actionable de-biasing targets for trustworthy financial LLM deployment

title: e-GAI: e-value-based Generalized α-Investing for Online False Discovery Rate Control
venue: International Conference on Machine Learning
one_liner: 基于e-value的generalized α-investing框架(e-LORD/e-SAFFRON)→ 任意依赖下在线FDR控制且更高power(含金融泡沫与异常检测)
ai_mechanism: e-value-based online FDR framework with new FDP estimator + risk-aversion-investing (RAI) dynamic testing-level allocation; mem-variants combat α-death
target_quantity: online false discovery rate / power in sequential hypothesis testing
incumbent_beaten: e-LOND, LORD++, SAFFRON, SupLORD
novelty_angle: GAI-like e-value framework giving provable online FDR under arbitrary dependence while dynamically allocating levels for higher power
data_used: synthetic Gaussian + NYC taxi anomaly + Nasdaq monthly prices for bubble dating; price-only, findata-native
why_accepted: new e-value online-testing framework with FDR guarantees under general dependence + demonstrable power gains, two new algorithms

title: Estimating Covariance for Global Minimum Variance Portfolio: A Decision-Focused Learning Approach
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 用decision-focused learning(regret loss)而非MSE学习协方差 → 直接最小化GMVP组合波动率(优于shrinkage与PFL)
ai_mechanism: decision-focused learning: DLinear predicts covariance, differentiable GMVP optimization layer, regret loss backprop through closed-form weights; theoretical gradient PCA characterization
target_quantity: covariance matrix → GMVP weights minimizing realized portfolio volatility
incumbent_beaten: Ledoit-Wolf (LW-D/LW-CC), OAS shrinkage, historical sample cov, equal-weight, MSE-based PFL
novelty_angle: first DFL for covariance estimation in GMVP; proves decision-gradient principal-component structure; shows MSE-PFL collapses to near-equal-weight
data_used: daily returns S&P100, 49 Industry (Ken French), Dow30, 2010-2024; findata-native, FF factors constructible
why_accepted: novel decision-aware covariance estimation with theoretical gradient analysis + consistent volatility reduction vs classical shrinkage and PFL

title: FinDER: Financial Dataset for Question Answering and Evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 用专家标注的真实简短/缩写金融查询(干预)暴露SOTA RAG检索召回率崩塌(指标:Context Recall/Correctness)
ai_mechanism: expert-annotated query–evidence–answer triplets from 10-K filings; dense/sparse retrieval + LLM reranking + generation, evaluated via LLM-as-judge (RAGAS)
target_quantity: retrieval recall/precision and answer correctness/faithfulness on ambiguous financial queries
has_classical_optimum: no — IR retrieval has no closed-form optimum
incumbent_beaten: BM25 and prior financial QA datasets (FinQA, FinanceBench) with clean predefined contexts
novelty_angle: first dataset capturing real professional query brevity/ambiguity (acronyms like 'MS'), forcing retrieval as core task rather than given context
data_used: S&P 500 10-K filings + real hedge-fund analyst queries; findata-native (text/fundamentals), needs SEC EDGAR text
why_accepted: realistic expert-annotated RAG benchmark exposing that even E5-Mistral + frontier LLMs fail on ambiguous financial retrieval

title: CVE-LLM: Ontology-Assisted Automatic Vulnerability Evaluation Using Large Language Models
venue: AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
one_liner: 用领域自适应预训练+本体知识图谱注入(干预)提升医疗设备CVE漏洞评估的分类/生成质量(指标:micro-F1/ROUGE-L)
ai_mechanism: domain-adaptive pretraining (DAPT) then SFT of a decoder LLM, with cybersecurity-ontology (CVE/CWE/CAPEC) enrichment + rule-based post-correction, human-in-the-loop deployment
target_quantity: vulnerability evaluation labels (VEX category/justification, CVSS vector) and free-text comments
incumbent_beaten: fine-tuned Llama2-7B, Mistral-7B, Llama3-RAG; human expert (50-100x slower)
novelty_angle: first real-world deployed LLM for medical-device vulnerability evaluation; ontology enrichment generalizes to unseen CVEs without retraining
data_used: 350K CVE/NVD + Siemens internal vulnerability docs; NOT finance — cybersecurity domain (finance only as venue tangent)
why_accepted: deployed industrial system with 50-100x speedup, ontology-injection ablation showing deployment-time gains on unseen assets

title: FinAgentBench: A Benchmark Dataset for Agentic Retrieval in Financial Question Answering
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 用两阶段(文档类型→chunk)agentic检索benchmark(干预)揭示LLM在chunk级细粒度检索上崩塌(指标:nDCG/MAP/MRR)
ai_mechanism: decompose retrieval into document-type ranking + chunk ranking via multi-step LLM reasoning; reinforcement fine-tuning for domain adaptation
target_quantity: ranking quality at document-type and intra-document chunk levels
has_classical_optimum: no — learned ranking, no filter optimum
incumbent_beaten: single-stage sparse/dense retrievers (BM25, DPR, E5-Mistral); zero-shot LLMs before fine-tuning
novelty_angle: first benchmark for multi-step 'agentic' retrieval reflecting how analysts navigate filing conventions (risk→10-K, proposals→DEF-14A); reveals chunk-level reasoning gap
data_used: 26K expert annotations over S&P-500 SEC filings (10-K/10-Q/8-K/earnings/DEF-14A); findata-native text, needs EDGAR
why_accepted: novel two-stage agentic-retrieval task; strong doc-type priors but exposes large chunk-level failure, RFT closes part of gap

title: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets
venue: AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
one_liner: 用专用K线tokenizer+自回归预训练(12B records, 45市场)(干预)做零样本价格/波动率预测与合成生成(指标:RankIC/MAE/Disc.Score)
ai_mechanism: Binary Spherical Quantization tokenizer discretizing OHLCVA into coarse/fine subtokens; decoder-only autoregressive next-token pretraining; test-time MC-rollout ensembling
target_quantity: cross-sectional price/return forecasts (RankIC), realized volatility (MAE/R2), synthetic K-line fidelity
has_classical_optimum: partial — GARCH/HAR optimal for volatility only
incumbent_beaten: leading TSFMs (TimeMOE, Chronos, Moirai), non-pretrained iTransformer/PatchTST, GARCH/ARCH for volatility
novelty_angle: first TSFM that beats specialized non-pretrained models on financial K-lines; discrete tokenization tackles low-SNR/non-stationarity where generic TSFMs underperform
data_used: 12B OHLCVA K-line records, 45 global exchanges, 7 frequencies; findata-native price/volume, needs intraday + non-US
why_accepted: demonstrates pretraining scaling laws hold for finance via domain-specific tokenization; SOTA across forecasting, volatility, generation, backtest

title: FinReflectKG: Agentic Construction and Evaluation of Financial Knowledge Graphs
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 用反思型critic-corrector agent循环(干预)提升SEC 10-K知识图谱抽取的schema合规度与覆盖度(指标:CheckRules compliance/coverage/LLM-judge)
ai_mechanism: schema-guided iterative triple extraction with table-aware chunking; reflection agent (feedback+correction LLM loop) vs single/multi-pass; rule + entropy + LLM-as-judge evaluation
target_quantity: quality/compliance/coverage of extracted (head,type,rel,tail,type) financial KG triples
incumbent_beaten: single-pass and multi-pass LLM extraction baselines; news-based prior financial KGs
novelty_angle: first large-scale open S&P-100 10-K KG with reflection-agent extraction; holistic multi-metric eval without ground-truth triples
data_used: SEC 10-K filings of all S&P 100 (2024); findata-native text, needs EDGAR
why_accepted: released open dataset + generalizable agentic-extraction + multi-faceted evaluation framework showing reflection wins coverage/compliance tradeoff

title: Your AI, Not Your View: The Bias of LLMs in Investment Analysis
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 用平衡/失衡对立证据的知识冲突探针(干预)量化LLM对sector/size/momentum的潜在偏好与确认偏误(指标:bias score/decision flip rate/entropy)
ai_mechanism: three-stage framework: generate balanced buy/sell evidence, elicit bias via knowledge conflict, verify persistence under escalating counter-evidence (volume & intensity); Shannon entropy of action tokens
target_quantity: directional bias score per factor and decision-flip rate under counter-evidence
has_classical_optimum: no — measures model behavior not estimation
incumbent_beaten: prior single-sentence/name-swap bias detection methods that ignore conflicting-signal synthesis
novelty_angle: realistic conflicting-evidence testbed showing universal tech/large-cap/contrarian bias escalating into confirmation bias; links bias strength to decision rigidity & entropy
data_used: 427 long-tenured S&P 500 tickers, LLM-generated synthetic evidence; findata-native concepts (sector/size/momentum), no external data needed
why_accepted: systematic bias audit framework + public leaderboard establishing trustworthiness as a benchmark for financial LLMs

title: FAITH: A Framework for Assessing Intrinsic Tabular Hallucinations in Finance
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 用对10-K数值跨度的掩码填空任务(干预)按推理复杂度分层度量LLM内在表格幻觉率(指标:span accuracy by reasoning type A-D)
ai_mechanism: automated context-aware masked-span prediction over XBRL tables with uniqueness/consistency/answerability filtering; precision-relaxed numeric+unit matching; 4-level reasoning taxonomy
target_quantity: recovery accuracy of masked numerical values across direct-lookup→multivariate calculation complexity
has_classical_optimum: yes — ground-truth value deterministic from table arithmetic
incumbent_beaten: frontier LLMs (Claude-Sonnet-4, Gemini-2.5-Pro 10-20% error on multivariate; open-source ~0% on complex)
novelty_angle: scalable auto-constructed intrinsic-hallucination benchmark on real financial tables; shows accuracy collapses systematically with numeric reasoning depth + scale errors
data_used: S&P 500 10-K reports (2024) XBRL from EDGAR; findata-native text/fundamentals, needs structured tables
why_accepted: novel masking paradigm enabling automated finance-specific hallucination eval with deterministic ground truth, exposing multi-step reasoning fragility

title: Navigating the Social Welfare Frontier: Portfolios for Multi-objective Reinforcement Learning
venue: International Conference on Machine Learning
one_liner: 用α-近似策略组合算法覆盖所有generalized p-mean福利函数(干预),以小组合近最优地总结p≤1策略空间(指标:approximation factor vs portfolio size/oracle calls)
ai_mechanism: p-MeanPortfolio line-search algorithm + budget-constrained greedy heuristic computing finite α-approximate policy portfolios across p-mean welfare family, with warm-start guarantees
target_quantity: minimal set of policies α-approximately optimal across all p≤1 social welfare functions
has_classical_optimum: partial — Pareto/convex-coverage sets known but not for p-means
incumbent_beaten: Pareto-front approximation, convex coverage sets, random-p / random-policy sampling baselines
novelty_angle: first portfolio with provable approximation guarantees over the full p-mean welfare family with bounded size/oracle complexity; fairness-axiomatic, not arbitrary scalarization
data_used: synthetic taxi + disaster-resource-allocation + real ARMMAN healthcare RMAB data; NOT finance ('portfolio' is decision-theoretic, not asset)
why_accepted: theoretical bounds on approximation/size/compute tradeoff + warm-start analysis + empirical near-optimal small portfolios across 3 domains

title: Curriculum-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Synthesizing Gas-Efficient Financial Derivatives Contracts
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 两阶段课程式PPO从CDM衍生品规格选择代码片段(干预X)→生成的Solidity智能合约gas成本(指标Y,最高降35.59%)
ai_mechanism: two-phase curriculum RL (PPO over discrete code-snippet action space): phase-1 reward shaping for compilation correctness, phase-2 normalized gas-budget reward; Foundry compile/test oracle as environment
target_quantity: deployment + execution gas cost of generated derivative smart contracts
incumbent_beaten: phase-1 functionally-correct-but-unoptimized agent baseline; static gas analyzers (GasChecker/Slither) implicitly
novelty_angle: unify correctness + gas optimization during synthesis (not post-hoc), curriculum makes sparse-reward code-gen tractable
data_used: synthetic CDM derivative contracts (5 types, 1000 each); needs blockchain/Solidity tooling, not findata-native
why_accepted: first RL pipeline co-optimizing functional correctness and on-chain gas from high-level financial specs; concrete 35.59% gas reduction + qualitative learned patterns

title: Langevin Multiplicative Weights Update with Applications in Polynomial Portfolio Management
venue: AAAI (Association for the Advancement of Artificial Intelligence)
one_liner: 在Shahshahani几何下给MWU加几何缩放噪声(干预X)→单纯形约束非凸全局最优收敛 + 高阶矩多项式组合损失(指标Y)
ai_mechanism: Langevin Multiplicative Weights Update: geometric-Brownian-motion noise scaled by Shahshahani (Hessian-manifold) metric on simplex, non-asymptotic global-convergence proof via log-Sobolev/Talagrand
target_quantity: interior global minimum of polynomial (MV/MVS/MVSK) portfolio loss over product of simplices
has_classical_optimum: partial (Markowitz convex only; non-convex moments hard)
incumbent_beaten: MWU, Accelerated MWU, Projected Langevin (lower out-of-sample loss across all risk preferences)
novelty_angle: first MWU variant provably reaching global (not just second-order stationary) optima under distributed simplex constraints; couples game-theory optimizer with Langevin global search
data_used: 10 NASDAQ stocks daily 2011-2021 returns; findata-native (price-only)
why_accepted: new algorithm with non-asymptotic global-convergence guarantee on simplex + empirical portfolio gains; fills MWU-global-optima gap

title: Scaling Conditional Autoencoders for Portfolio Optimization via Uncertainty-Aware Factor Selection
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 高维CAE(K=50)+按预测不确定性排序剪枝latent因子(干预X)→切线组合风险调整收益Sharpe/Sortino/Omega(指标Y)
ai_mechanism: high-dim conditional autoencoder latent factors + per-factor quantile forecast uncertainty (ZS-Chronos TSFM / quantile gradient-boosted trees / IID bootstrap) used to rank and prune factors; LSE-smoothed adaptive kappa selection; performance-weighted ensemble tangency portfolio
target_quantity: out-of-sample risk-adjusted return of factor-space tangency portfolio
incumbent_beaten: conventional low-dim (K=5) CAE benchmarks; SPY; individual forecasters
novelty_angle: forecast uncertainty as sufficient statistic for utility-loss → uncertainty-aware dimensionality control lets CAE scale to K=50 without degradation; pretrained TSFM in pipeline with leakage ablation
data_used: 2000 largest US stocks monthly 1962-2024, 153 long-short characteristic factors (Jensen-Kelly-Pedersen); findata-native (price+fundamentals/characteristics)
why_accepted: breaks the K≈5 CAE ceiling via decision-aligned factor selection; strong OOS metrics (Sharpe 2.2, MDD<10%) + rigorous Chronos look-ahead-bias ablation

title: Latent Variable Estimation in Bayesian Black-Litterman Models
venue: International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML)
one_liner: 把Black-Litterman投资者观点(q,Ω)当作隐变量从特征数据学习(干预X)→view-free闭式后验组合的Sharpe(+50%)与换手率(-55%)(指标Y)
ai_mechanism: Bayesian network reformulation of Black-Litterman treating views (q,Ω) as latent; two feature-integration mechanisms (shared-latent-parametrization, feature-influenced-views) with closed-form Gaussian/NIW-student-t posteriors recovering classical BL & Markowitz as limits
target_quantity: posterior over asset returns / view-free portfolio weights (Sharpe, turnover)
incumbent_beaten: Markowitz, S&P500/DJIA index baselines (Sharpe 0.66-0.87 vs 0.35-0.62)
novelty_angle: removes subjective human views via coherent single Bayesian network, unifying feature integration + parameter inference, avoiding external-estimator error propagation
data_used: 30-yr Dow Jones, 20-yr sector ETFs; findata-native (price-only features)
why_accepted: principled probabilistic-graphical recasting of BL with closed-form posteriors + theoretical recovery of classical models and ground-truth-limit analysis; large empirical Sharpe/turnover gains

title: FinBen: A Holistic Financial Benchmark for Large Language Models
venue: Neural Information Processing Systems
one_liner: 36数据集/24任务/7维度(含首个股票交易+agent+RAG评测)评测15个LLM(干预X)→揭示LLM在预测/文本生成/风险管理上的系统性失败(指标Y)
ai_mechanism: holistic zero/few-shot evaluation harness across IE/TA/QA/TG/RM/FO/DM, plus agent-based (FinMem) trading and RAG evaluation strategies
target_quantity: per-task LLM accuracy/F1/MCC/ROUGE and trading SR/CR/MDD across 15 models
incumbent_beaten: none beaten — exposes GPT-4/Gemini failures: forecasting ≈ random guessing, MCC≈0 on imbalanced risk tasks, weak extractive summarization
novelty_angle: first benchmark covering stock trading + agent/RAG eval; shows forecasting/RM as hard-floor tasks where LLMs lag traditional methods
data_used: 36 datasets incl. stock-movement (price+tweets), credit/fraud tabular, SEC filings, EMIR regulations; mostly findata-native but US-only English
why_accepted: most comprehensive open-source financial LLM benchmark, hosted IJCAI-2024 shared task; clear SOTA-limitation findings driving the field

title: FINCON: A Synthesized LLM Multi-Agent System with Conceptual Verbal Reinforcement for Enhanced Financial Decision Making
venue: Neural Information Processing Systems
one_liner: manager-analyst层级+CVaR内episode风控+概念性口头强化跨episode信念更新(干预X)→单股交易与组合管理的CR/SR/MDD(指标Y)
ai_mechanism: hierarchical manager-analyst LLM multi-agent POMDP solved by textual-gradient-descent verbal reinforcement; dual-level risk control (within-episode CVaR trigger + over-episode conceptual belief update via Actor-Critic CVRF); selective belief back-propagation
target_quantity: cumulative return, Sharpe, max drawdown over single-stock and portfolio trading
incumbent_beaten: DRL agents (A2C/PPO/DQN), LLM agents (GA/FinGPT/FinMem/FinAgent), Buy&Hold, Markowitz MV, FinRL-A2C
novelty_angle: CVaR-grounded quant risk measure + conceptual verbal-RL belief refinement with action-overlap learning rate; generalizes language agents beyond single-asset to portfolio management with reduced comm cost
data_used: 8 stocks + 2 small portfolios, prices/news/10-K/10-Q/ECC audio Jan2022-Jun2023; findata-native plus audio/filings
why_accepted: novel synthesized hierarchy + dual-level risk control beating DRL and prior LLM agents with only 4 training episodes; ablations isolate CVaR and belief-update contributions

title: Enhancing Investment Analysis: Optimizing AI-Agent Collaboration in Financial Research
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 变化agent组规模(single/dual/triple)与协作结构(horizontal/vertical/hybrid)(干预X)→不同子任务(基本面/情绪/风险)的报告质量与买入决策准确率(指标Y)
ai_mechanism: configurable multi-agent collaboration over RAG+function-calling on 10-K filings; horizontal (group chat), vertical (nested-chat leader-subordinate), hybrid structures; ensemble = per-subtask optimal structure
target_quantity: GPT-4-judged subtask quality (1-5), 1-week target-price avg diff, buy/not-buy binary accuracy
incumbent_beaten: single-agent and uniform multi-agent baselines (ensemble 2.35% price diff, 66.7% buy accuracy vs 50% full-vertical)
novelty_angle: task-difficulty drives optimal topology: single/horizontal best for simple info-gathering (fundamentals/sentiment), vertical-leader best for decision-heavy risk analysis; information-flow analysis explains why
data_used: 2023 10-K of 30 DJIA firms + prices/news/Reddit via FMP/YFinance/Finnhub/PRAW; findata-native + social/filings
why_accepted: systematic mapping of agent group-size/structure to financial subtask performance with information-flow explanation and ensemble result; practical FinRobot guidelines

title: FinDKG: Dynamic Knowledge Graphs with Large Language Models for Detecting Global Trends in Financial Markets
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 微调开源LLM(ICKG)从财经新闻抽取带meta-entity的动态KG + meta-entity感知图注意力GNN(KGTransformer)(干预X)→链接预测MRR/Hits与AI主题组合收益(指标Y)
ai_mechanism: fine-tuned Mistral-7B (ICKG, GPT-4-distilled) for temporal KG quintuple extraction; KGTransformer = HGT-style meta-entity-aware multi-head graph attention + EvoKG temporal/structural RNN embeddings; log-normal-mixture event-time + MLP link-prediction
target_quantity: link-prediction MRR/Hits@3,10 and AI-theme long-only portfolio return/Sharpe
incumbent_beaten: R-GCN, RE-Net, EvoKG on link prediction (~10% MRR uplift on FinDKG); AI ETFs (ARKK/IRBO/IGPT) and SPY/QQQ on thematic portfolio
novelty_angle: meta-entity (entity-category) information injected into dynamic-KG attention yields large gains when categories available; LLM-generated open-source financial DKG enables thematic-investing link prediction
data_used: ~400k WSJ articles 1999-2023 → FinDKG; benchmark DKGs (YAGO/WIKI/ICEWS14); findata-native text (news) + price for backtest
why_accepted: three contributions (open ICKG LLM, open FinDKG dataset, KGTransformer architecture) with SOTA link prediction and a profitable AI-theme portfolio (Sharpe 1.81 vs ETFs <0.82)

title: Decision Making under the Exponential Family: Distributionally Robust Optimisation with Bayesian Ambiguity Sets
venue: International Conference on Machine Learning
one_liner: 干预X=用posterior-informed Bayesian ambiguity set做worst-case风险优化 → 指标Y=组合out-of-sample mean-variance权衡与求解速度
ai_mechanism: distributionally robust optimisation with KL-ball ambiguity sets centered on Bayesian posterior predictive / posterior-expectation, with strong-dual single-stage stochastic program for the conjugate exponential family
target_quantity: worst-case expected risk of a decision (inventory level / portfolio weights)
incumbent_beaten: Bayesian DRO (BDRO, Shapiro et al. 2023); Pareto-dominates on Newsvendor, comparable robustness but orders-of-magnitude faster on Portfolio
novelty_angle: single worst-case-risk distribution (vs BDRO's expected-worst-case two-stage program) yielding closed-form Gaussian-linear dual with no sampling
data_used: findata-native — weekly DowJones 28-stock returns (Bruni et al. 2016); price-only
why_accepted: new strong-duality theory across the whole conjugate exponential family plus finite-sample tolerance results and faster solve times with comparable robustness

title: Deep Learning for Options Trading: An End-To-End Approach
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 干预X=端到端神经网络直接由期权特征学交易信号(Sharpe为损失) → 指标Y=delta-neutral straddle组合的风险调整收益(Sharpe/Sortino/Calmar)
ai_mechanism: end-to-end neural nets (Linear/MLP/CNN/LSTM) mapping option features directly to position sizes, trained by maximizing Sharpe ratio with turnover regularization, bypassing any option-pricing model
target_quantity: trading signal / position size X∈[-1,1] per straddle
has_classical_optimum: partial — Black-Scholes-SABR pricing exists but deliberately bypassed
incumbent_beaten: rules-based trend strategies (TSMOM, MACD, Heston option-momentum TS/CS); LSTM Sharpe 1.33 vs TSMR 0.76
novelty_angle: integrates trend prediction and position sizing in one model with no option-pricing-model or market-dynamics assumption; turnover regularization preserves edge at high transaction costs
data_used: needs options — OptionMetrics Ivy DB S&P100 straddles + CRSP underlying
why_accepted: first scalable end-to-end ML options-trading framework with decade-long backtest and clear Sharpe improvement plus transaction-cost robustness

title: InvestESG: A Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Benchmark for Studying Climate Investment as a Social Dilemma
venue: International Conference on Learning Representations
one_liner: 干预X=ESG披露强制+ESG-conscious投资者占比/绿洗/信息供给 → 指标Y=企业mitigation支出、最终气候风险、市场总财富
ai_mechanism: multi-agent RL benchmark (Independent PPO) over an intertemporal social dilemma with company and investor agents, climate-risk Bernoulli dynamics, and Schelling-diagram analysis
target_quantity: equilibrium corporate mitigation/greenwashing/resilience allocation and social outcome metrics (P100, W100)
incumbent_beaten: two-agent / single-period theoretical economics models (Pastor 2021, Friedman 2021) and pure empirical analysis (no counterfactuals)
novelty_angle: MARL benchmark tied to a concrete contested policy (SEC ESG mandate) producing directional results consistent with empirical literature plus novel findings (greenwashing less harmful than feared, info alone helps)
data_used: findata-native-adjacent — calibrated to IPCC/S&P500/WFE aggregates; no firm-level financial dataset, simulation environment
why_accepted: open-source PyTorch+JAX MARL benchmark addressing a high-impact real-world policy question, validated against empirical evidence

title: Hopfield Networks for Asset Allocation
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 干预X=用Modern Hopfield Network(替换LSTM/self-attention)做端到端组合配置 → 指标Y=combinatorial-purged-CV下的Sharpe/Sortino/drawdown
ai_mechanism: modern Hopfield (dense associative memory) network used as a pooling layer or attention replacement to map asset-return time series to softmax portfolio weights, trained to maximize Sharpe
target_quantity: long-only portfolio weight vector
incumbent_beaten: ties LSTM/Transformer on ETF/STOCKS/FAMAFRENCH; Hopfield Encoder beats LSTM on COMMODITIES; but all DL methods lose to MVO/HRP on multi-regime COMMODITIES/FAMAFRENCH
novelty_angle: first application of modern Hopfield networks to portfolio optimization with rigorous combinatorial-purged-CV + Tukey-HSD statistical testing, faster training
data_used: findata-native — daily prices for ETFs, 66 Nasdaq stocks, Fama-French 10-industry, 19 commodities (Yahoo + FF library)
why_accepted: novel architecture transfer plus unusually rigorous CPCV evaluation honestly reporting DL failure under multi-regime data

title: ARL-Based Multi-Action Market Making with Hawkes Processes and Variable Volatility
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 干预X=用Hawkes自激发到达+对抗RL训练多动作(双边/单边/不报价)做市商 → 指标Y=不同波动率下的terminal wealth/Sharpe/报价比例
ai_mechanism: adversarial reinforcement learning (SAC adversary + DQN market maker) in a zero-sum game with Hawkes self-exciting trade-arrival intensity and a 4-action quoting space
target_quantity: market-maker quoting action (none/two-sided/ask-only/bid-only) and bid-ask offsets
has_classical_optimum: partial — Avellaneda-Stoikov/Almgren-Chriss stochastic-control MM under Poisson
incumbent_beaten: prior Poisson-based ARL MM (Spooner-Savani 2020) and flexible-quote MM (Wang 2023); shows low-vol-trained 4-action MM adapts to high vol, quoting two-sided >=92%
novelty_angle: swaps Poisson for Hawkes self-exciting dynamics and studies cross-volatility transfer of multi-action quoting under adversarial training
data_used: needs intraday — simulated LOB (mbt_gym Hawkes arrival model), no real data
why_accepted: more realistic self-exciting market simulation plus volatility-regime transfer analysis extending the multi-action ARL line

title: Dynamic Pricing in Securities Lending Market: Application in Revenue Optimization for an Agent Lender Portfolio
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 干预X=把代理出借方定价当作上下文老虎机(LinUCB/LRUCB/EG/LRTS)+自定义revenue-propensity奖励 → 指标Y=离线评估总收入(>=15%提升)
ai_mechanism: contextual multi-armed bandit (Thompson sampling / UCB / epsilon-greedy with logistic-regression booking-status estimator) over market supply-demand context to choose lending-fee actions, with off-policy offline evaluation
target_quantity: lending-fee / offer rate (action arm) maximizing expected revenue, minimizing regret
has_classical_optimum: no — no ground-truth optimal rate, bilateral OTC market
incumbent_beaten: rule-based pricing, supervised ML pricing, own-VWAF, market-VWAF; CB methods beat all by >=15% revenue, LRTS best
novelty_angle: frames securities-lending (e-commerce-like bilateral market, not LOB) as contextual-bandit dynamic pricing with a custom booking-preference x booking-status reward balancing hit-rate vs price
data_used: needs non-public — proprietary NGT autoborrow bid-level + market-share/utilization features (J.P. Morgan)
why_accepted: first contextual-bandit application to the under-studied securities-lending market with realistic reward design and unbiased offline evaluation on real demand data

title: Last-iterate Convergence in Regularized Graphon Mean Field Game
venue: Neural Information Processing Systems (preprint/under review)
one_liner: 干预X=正则化单调graphon mean-field game上的镜像下降 → 指标Y=到Nash均衡的last-iterate收敛速率(bandit O(T^-1/4)、full-info O(T^-1)、linear O(T^-1/5))
ai_mechanism: policy mirror descent with entropy regularization and importance-sampling gradient estimation for tabular/linear graphon mean-field games, with last-iterate convergence proofs
target_quantity: policy iterate's KL distance to the (unique) Nash equilibrium
has_classical_optimum: partial — fictitious play converges in time-average only
incumbent_beaten: fictitious play baseline (heavier per-iteration) and prior average-iterate-only GMFG guarantees (Zhang 2023)
novelty_angle: first last-iterate (not time-average) convergence rates for regularized monotone GMFG under bandit feedback, motivated by many-trader-in-markets modeling
data_used: findata-native-irrelevant — synthetic GMFG environments (Predator-Prey, Crowd, Periodic Aversion via OpenSpiel); finance is motivating application only
why_accepted: first last-iterate convergence theory for graphon mean-field games closing a known gap, with matching strongly-convex rate under full info

title: Numin: Weighted-Majority Ensembles for Intraday Trading
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 干预X=按近窗accuracy或utility动态加权多数投票(EMA)集成8个模型预测10-candle收益 → 指标Y=离散收益分类accuracy与模拟交易utility(平均每笔盈利)
ai_mechanism: dynamic weighted-majority-algorithm ensemble of 8 deep models with EMA-updated weights scored over a recent window by either accuracy or a profitability-proxy utility metric
target_quantity: discretised 5-class 10-candle return prediction and resulting long/short position utility
incumbent_beaten: each of the 8 individual models and a hypothetical average-of-models; utility-weighted WMA over short (25-min) window gives positive average utility while individual models are mostly negative
novelty_angle: uses a trading-specific utility (profitability proxy), not accuracy, as the online re-weighting metric over short windows, with masking-based realistic trade simulation; Numerai-style real-time intraday model rewarding
data_used: needs intraday/non-US — 5-min OHLCV candles, Indian equities (Sep 2023–Jun 2024)
why_accepted: demonstrates decision-aware (utility-based) dynamic ensembling beats individual models and accuracy-weighting under realistic intraday simulation

title: NeuralFactors: A Novel Factor Learning Approach to Generative Modeling of Equities
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: VAE/CIWAE-based learned factor exposures+returns (X) → joint return log-likelihood, covariance forecasting, VaR calibration, MV-optimized portfolio Sharpe (Y) on S&P 500
ai_mechanism: conditional importance-weighted variational autoencoder with linear Student-T decoder outputting per-stock factor exposures + latent factor returns; closed-form mean/covariance
target_quantity: joint conditional return distribution p(r_{t+1}|F_t), covariance matrix, portfolio weights
incumbent_beaten: BDG (Tepelyan-Gopal generative ML), PPCA; GARCH still wins on VaR calibration
novelty_angle: factor exposures inferred end-to-end (not predefined like FF/Barra, not latent-only like prior deep generators), giving interpretable Barra-style exposures + 80x compute savings (24 vs 2000 GPU-hrs)
data_used: needs CRSP/options/volume — point-in-time S&P500 daily returns + company financials + factor indices + put/call open-interest ratios (not findata-native, needs options + PIT constituents)
why_accepted: beats strong deep-generative incumbent on NLL+covariance+portfolio with large compute reduction, interpretable factors clustering by sector, thorough ablations

title: Return Prediction for Mean-Variance Portfolio Selection: How Decision-Focused Learning Shapes Forecasting Models
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: Decision-focused (regret) loss vs MSE loss (X) → return-prediction bias structure, portfolio concentration, Sharpe/MDD (Y) on DOW30/S&P100
ai_mechanism: decision-focused learning: differentiate through the argmax of MVO quadratic program; combined loss α·regret + (1-α)·MSE backpropagated through optimization layer
target_quantity: expected-return vector μ̂ feeding mean-variance optimal portfolio weights
incumbent_beaten: pure-MSE predict-then-optimize baseline (α=0)
novelty_angle: mechanistic theory: DFL gradient = MSE error tilted by Σ⁻¹, explaining why DFL strategically over/under-estimates IN vs OUT assets — 'biases are features not flaws', resolving why DFL wins despite higher MSE
data_used: findata-native — DOW30/S&P100 daily returns 2010-2024, 60-day lookback, sample covariance
why_accepted: opens the DFL black box with closed-form Σ⁻¹-tilting mechanism + matching empirical bias polarization across α/λ grid; reframes accuracy metrics as misleading for portfolio use

title: EX-DRL: Hedging Against Heavy Losses with Extreme Distributional Reinforcement Learning
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: GPD-modeled tail injected into quantile-regression DRL critic (X) → extreme-quantile VaR/CVaR accuracy and hedged PnL under high vol (Y) for gamma option hedging
ai_mechanism: distributional RL (QR-D4PG actor-critic) with mixture target distribution: body as quantile mixture + left tail as negated Generalized Pareto Distribution fit by MLE, extra tail sampling
target_quantity: return-distribution extreme quantiles (VaR_α, CVaR_α at α=0.95,0.99) and hedging policy
has_classical_optimum: partial — Black-Scholes Greeks/Almgren exist but myopic
incumbent_beaten: QR-D4PG (vanilla quantile-regression DRL); classical Greek-neutral hedging
novelty_angle: replaces under-covered QR tail with extreme-value-theory GPD to enrich rare-event samples without raising quantile count, giving stable CVaR (constraining shape ε<1 for finite mean), more vol-adaptive hedge ratio
data_used: needs options/simulated — simulated GBM underlying + Black-Scholes option pricing, 30-day gamma hedging (synthetic, not findata-native)
why_accepted: targets a named hard property (tail under-coverage in QR-DRL) with EVT-principled fix, compatible with any QR method, demonstrably better VaR/CVaR and PnL spread as volatility rises

title: Contrastive Learning of Asset Embeddings from Financial Time Series
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: Hypothesis-test-sampled contrastive learning on return co-occurrence (X) → asset embeddings for sector classification F1 and hedge-pair out-of-sample volatility (Y) on 611 US stocks
ai_mechanism: contrastive representation learning with proportion-test (z-statistic/p-value) positive/negative sampling over rolling-window top-k return similarity; sigmoid/aggregate/hybrid losses
target_quantity: d-dim asset embedding vectors capturing co-movement relationships
incumbent_beaten: time-series classifiers (WEASEL/MUSE/Arsenal), prior embedding methods (node2vec-corr, Dolphin, Sarmah), Pearson-correlation hedging
novelty_angle: statistical hypothesis-testing sampling strategy explicitly built for low-SNR financial data to choose informative positives/negatives, beating handcrafted-similarity and prior embeddings on both classification and risk hedging
data_used: findata-native — 611 US stock daily returns 2000-2018 + GICS labels (returns-only)
why_accepted: novel noise-aware sampling adapts contrastive learning to financial stochasticity, SOTA sector-classification F1 (0.69) and statistically significant lower hedge volatility, embeddings recover finer-than-GICS relationships

title: Gambling-Based Confidence Sequences for Bounded Random Vectors
venue: International Conference on Machine Learning
one_liner: Universal-portfolio (Cover/KT-mixture) gambling wealth process (X) → tighter anytime-valid confidence sequences for multivariate bounded means (Y)
ai_mechanism: multivariate extension of coin-toss betting via K-horse-race gambling; KT/Dirichlet-mixture and Cover universal-portfolio wealth processes + Ville's inequality for supermartingale CS
target_quantity: time-uniform confidence set for the mean μ of bounded vector-valued stochastic processes
incumbent_beaten: posterior-prior-ratio martingale (Waudby-Smith-Ramdas), Bonferroni-aggregated scalar CS, Sison-Glaz
novelty_angle: recasts coin-toss CS as continuous K-horse race enabling categorical/probability-vector CS; proves KT CS provably tighter than PPR for sampling-without-replacement (~26% faster stopping)
data_used: findata-native (n/a) — simulated categorical/Dirichlet data; finance only as motivating analogy (Cover universal portfolio = stock market investment)
why_accepted: first general gambling framework for bounded vector CS with convexity/non-vacuous/provable-tightness guarantees and information-theoretic universal-portfolio connection; finance link is incidental

title: LENS: Large Pre-trained Transformer for Exploring Financial Time Series Regularities
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: Invertible-contrastive-embedding + time/channel-factorized attention pretrained on 100B financial points (X) → forecasting MSE/MAE, imputation, portfolio MDD/Sharpe (Y)
ai_mechanism: foundation-model pretraining: patch-level invertible embedding trained with InfoNCE contrastive + MSE reconstruction (frozen), then encoder-decoder TimeFormer with separate time-aware and channel-aware masked attention; Rademacher generalization bound under noise
target_quantity: general financial time-series representation for forecasting/imputation/portfolio tasks
incumbent_beaten: PatchTST, iTransformer, TimeMixer, TimesNet, DLinear, Crossformer, MICN, SegRNN; Markowitz/min-var portfolios
novelty_angle: foundation model purpose-built for low-SNR finance: invertible noise-robust embedding + factorized attention with theoretical Rademacher-complexity argument that fusion attention lowers generalization error in noise; scaling law shown
data_used: needs CRSP/intraday/options — 19 sub-datasets, 100B obs incl TAQ quotes/trades, CRSP, options, futures (heavily non-findata-native)
why_accepted: first open-source large-scale financial TS foundation model with theory tying architecture to noise-robust generalization, broad SOTA across forecasting/imputation/portfolio, clear scaling behavior

title: OCCAM: Towards Cost-Efficient and Accuracy-Aware Classification Inference
venue: International Conference on Learning Representations
one_liner: Nearest-neighbor unbiased low-variance accuracy estimator + ILP model assignment (X) → max aggregate classifier accuracy under cost budget (Y) on image benchmarks
ai_mechanism: per-query success-probability estimation via NN in pre-computed labeled samples (Lipschitz under r-separation) feeding a multiple-choice-knapsack integer linear program for optimal model portfolio, variance-regularized
target_quantity: optimal classifier-to-query assignment (model portfolio) maximizing accuracy s.t. cost budget
incumbent_beaten: FrugalMCT, single-best, random routing
novelty_angle: first white-box accuracy estimator with asymptotic unbiased/low-variance guarantees for hybrid inference, training-free, with deterministic budget satisfaction via ILP (vs learned probabilistic routers)
data_used: findata-native (n/a) — image classification (CIFAR/Tiny-ImageNet/ImageNet); 'portfolio' is model-selection not finance
why_accepted: principled statistically-guaranteed estimator under weak r-separation assumption + clean ILP formulation, 40% cost cut at <1% accuracy drop, beats learned-router baseline; not a finance paper

title: Adversarial Attacks on Data Attribution
venue: International Conference on Learning Representations
one_liner: Shadow-training and outlier (adversarial-example) perturbations (X) → inflated data-attribution-based compensation share (Y) in image/text settings
ai_mechanism: two attacks: Shadow Attack (gray-box, shadow-model training à la membership inference + Grad-Dot surrogate gradient ascent) and Outlier Attack (black-box adversarial examples exploiting outlier→high-influence inductive bias), with influence-function perturbation-stability theorem
target_quantity: top-k influence/attribution compensation share c(Z) of adversary-contributed data
has_classical_optimum: no — robustness of attribution not characterized
incumbent_beaten: heuristic duplication attack (Deng-Ma); random-perturbation baseline
novelty_angle: first principled threat model + attacks showing data-attribution compensation (influence function/TRAK/Data-Shapley) is adversarially manipulable to 185-643% inflation via imperceptible perturbations, with O(k/n) influence-stability proof
data_used: findata-native (n/a) — MNIST/Digits/CIFAR/Shakespeare; finance only via quant-trading periodic-data analogy
why_accepted: opens unstudied robustness gap, clear threat model with gray/black-box variants, strong empirical inflation across tasks + supporting influence-function theorem; auditing flavor, not finance-specific

title: DeltaLag: Learning Dynamic Lead-Lag Patterns in Financial Markets
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 干预X=端到端可学习的稀疏cross-attention动态lead-lag检测(pair-specific lag)→指标Y=long-short组合IC/年化收益/Sharpe
ai_mechanism: sparsified cross-attention scoring peer assets across lag offsets + top-k lag selection, then MLP on lag-aligned raw features, trained with monotonic log-sum-exp ranking loss end-to-end
target_quantity: next-day cross-sectional return ranking of lagger stocks
incumbent_beaten: statistical lead-lag graphs (Bennett et al. meta-flow/Hermitian clustering, lagged corr graphs) + temporal/spatio-temporal DL (PatchTST, DTML, Crossformer, TimesNet, MambaStock, THGNN, etc.)
novelty_angle: first end-to-end DL that jointly LEARNS which pairs lead and at what pair-specific time-varying lag, optimized directly for portfolio ranking; empirically confirms 'weak momentum' (historical lead-lag does not persist)
data_used: findata-native: US equities 2010-2023 (S&P500/NASDAQ/NYSE) daily split-adjusted price-volume; robust even with return-only feature
why_accepted: first-of-kind framing, beats both statistical lead-lag and SOTA DL, ~10bps/day above tx cost, plus interpretability (emergent leader clustering)

title: FIC-TSC: Learning Time Series Classification with Fisher Information Constraint
venue: International Conference on Machine Learning
one_liner: 干预X=训练时加Fisher-Information-Matrix(对角近似)约束引导收敛到平坦极小→指标Y=分布偏移下的分类准确率/F1
ai_mechanism: diagonal Fisher-information constraint via single-backprop gradient re-normalization that bounds FIM entrywise norm, steering optimizer toward flat minima for distribution-shift robustness
target_quantity: time-series classification accuracy/Macro-F1 under train-test domain shift
incumbent_beaten: RevIN/instance-norm, SAM sharpness-aware minimization, 14 SOTA TSC methods (MILLET, TodyNet, ConvTran, ROCKET, TimesNet, PatchTST, HC2, Hydra-MR)
novelty_angle: shows RevIN (works for forecasting) hurts classification by shrinking inter-class distance; replaces it with FIM-flatness constraint that needs only one backprop (vs SAM's two), with O(n) memory and provable O(1/T) convergence
data_used: NOT findata-native: 30 UEA + 85 UCR generic TSC archives + healthcare EEG/ECG; finance only motivational (regime segmentation)
why_accepted: theory (FIM↔Hessian↔sharpness link, convergence proof) + broad empirical wins over 14 baselines + half SAM runtime, ICML-grade rigor

title: Regret-Optimized Portfolio Enhancement through Deep Reinforcement Learning and Future Looking Rewards
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 干预X=PPO代理用Oracle-conditioned负Sharpe-regret reward + 交易成本调度 + circular-block-bootstrap合成数据增强→指标Y=年化收益/最大回撤/Calmar相对60/40基准
ai_mechanism: PPO with a future-looking regret reward = forward-return-weighted gap between agent allocation and Oracle Sharpe-optimal allocation; curriculum-style transaction-cost scheduler; circular block bootstrap synthetic-data regularization
target_quantity: dynamic 3-asset (equity/60-40/bonds) rebalancing weights maximizing return at controlled drawdown
incumbent_beaten: static 60/40 benchmark, Differential-Sharpe PPO (Sood et al.), embedded-drawdown reward PPO (Wu et al.)
novelty_angle: exploits that in portfolio RL the reward of ANY counterfactual action is known → regret-against-Oracle reward; combines with tx-cost curriculum + block-bootstrap to fight overfitting on single price path
data_used: findata-native: equity/bond/govies indices + VIX/MOVE/HY-spread contextual indexes, daily, 3 phased market regimes
why_accepted: novel decision-aware reward + honest train/val/test phased eval across pre/pandemic/post regimes + 'what didn't work' transparency (DDPG/A2C/GAIL fails)

title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Market Making: Competition without Collusion
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 干预X=分层MARL市场做市(自利/零和压制/混合ω-可调代理 + 对抗扰动环境)→指标Y=交互级结构指标(herding/quote-distance/fill-overlap/joint-drawdown) + PnL/spread/市场份额
ai_mechanism: hierarchical PPO actor-critic agents (adversary perturbs λ,σ; mid-layer maker; bottom-layer self-interested/zero-sum/hybrid with learnable modulation ω) over a simulated LOB with Poisson order flow and exponential fill probability
target_quantity: emergent interaction patterns (collusion vs competition) and market-quality metrics among heterogeneous makers
incumbent_beaten: none-numeric: positioned as agent-based simulation/auditing framework rather than beating a SOTA baseline
novelty_angle: behavior-structured hierarchy with a tunable self-interest↔suppression knob (ω) + a suite of interaction-level metrics; finds NO algorithmic collusion emerges (because price is exogenous) and hybrid agent gives more sustainable coexistence than rigid zero-sum suppressor
data_used: NOT findata-native: fully synthetic HFT environment (Brownian mid-price, Poisson order flow), no real data
why_accepted: timely algorithmic-collusion question + interpretable interaction metrics + clean contrast (B2 suppression vs B* hybrid) showing competition-without-collusion

title: ACT-Tensor: Tensor Completion Framework for Financial Dataset Imputation
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 干预X=cluster-based (density-grouped, sparse-borrows-from-dense) CP tensor completion + 时间平滑(CMA/EMA/Kalman)→指标Y=imputation RMSE/R2 + 下游asset-pricing α误差/IC/T-B Sharpe
ai_mechanism: CP tensor decomposition over firm×time×characteristic panel, density-thresholded K-means clustering where sparse clusters are augmented with dense-cluster data before completion, then per-series temporal smoothing
target_quantity: imputed firm-characteristic values under extreme/structured missingness, judged by downstream pricing utility
incumbent_beaten: cross-sectional median, matrix-factor methods Global BF-XS / Local B-XS (Bryzgalova et al.), vanilla CP, EM/GMM imputation
novelty_angle: clusters firms by data density and lets sparse clusters 'borrow statistical strength' from dense ones to avoid CP overfitting under ~83% missingness; evaluates imputation by asset-pricing profit (α, Sharpe) not just reconstruction error
data_used: needs CRSP/Compustat: monthly US panel 2016-2020, 22,630 stocks, 45 characteristics
why_accepted: addresses pervasive missing-data problem with structure-preserving method, large R2 gains under block/logit missingness, and decision-relevant downstream pricing evaluation

title: MARS: A Meta-Adaptive Reinforcement Learning Framework for Risk-Aware Multi-Agent Portfolio Management
venue: AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
one_liner: 干预X=异质Safety-Critic代理集成(各自风险阈值θ/λ) + Meta-Adaptive-Controller动态加权→指标Y=Sharpe/最大回撤/波动率跨牛熊regime
ai_mechanism: two-tier RL: ensemble of DDPG agents each with a Safety-Critic predicting an environment-risk score (concentration+leverage+simulated-vol) enforced via conditional safety penalty; a meta-controller outputs softmax weights blending agents by market state
target_quantity: daily portfolio allocation balancing return and downside risk across bull/bear regimes
incumbent_beaten: buy-and-hold index, DeepTrader, HRPM, AlphaStock; ablations MARS-Static/Homo/Div5/Div15
novelty_angle: decouples risk-preference (heterogeneous Safety-Critic agents spanning conservative→aggressive) from regime-adaptation (meta-controller reweighting), making risk proactive/structural rather than reward-shaping after-the-fact
data_used: findata-native: DJI + HSI daily 2016-2024, 50 stocks each, price + 4 technical indicators (MACD/RSI/CCI/ADX)
why_accepted: strong drawdown/Sharpe gains in 2022 bear AND 2024 bull, ablations isolate MAC and HAE contributions, interpretable regime-conditioned agent weighting

title: Aligning Language Models with Investor and Market Behavior for Financial Recommendations
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 干预X=LLM + 用户交易/市场知识图谱(PKG/MKG) + Kahneman-Tversky Optimization对齐(含联邦变体)→指标Y=行为对齐Pref@3 + 盈利Prof@3 + 联合Comb@3
ai_mechanism: serialize user transaction history + market price summaries as JSON-LD knowledge graphs into LLM context; fine-tune via KTO using binary desirability labels (purchased AND profitable); LoRA + 4-bit quantization with federated aggregation
target_quantity: top-3 asset recommendations that are simultaneously profitable and behaviorally aligned with actual user purchases
incumbent_beaten: FAR-Trans baselines: Random Forest, LightGBM, Linear Reg (price-based); LightGCN, ARM, MF, UB-kNN, Popularity (behavior-based)
novelty_angle: first to use KTO (prospect-theory alignment) for asset recommendation and first KG-grounded LLM reasoning over behavioral data in federated setting; shows mid-sized (1.7B-4B) models beat 8B, and 4B THRIVES under non-IID federation
data_used: findata-native-ish: FAR-Trans dataset (anonymized customer transactions + asset price history); needs transaction-level behavioral data
why_accepted: reframes recommendation success as joint profit+behavioral-alignment (Comb@3), novel KTO+KG+federated combination, resource-efficient and privacy-compliant

title: Interpreting Fedspeak with Confidence: A LLM-Based Uncertainty-Aware Framework Guided by Monetary Policy Transmission Paths
venue: AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
one_liner: 干预X=货币政策传导路径模板数据增强 + Dirichlet证据型动态不确定性解码(感知不确定性PU=认知风险CR×环境模糊EA)→指标Y=Fedspeak鹰/鸽/中立分类Macro/Weighted-F1 + PU↔错误率相关
ai_mechanism: template-based domain reasoning (extract financial entity relations → monetary-policy transmission-path chains → policy advice) augments input; top-k logits form a Dirichlet to compute evidence-based perceptual uncertainty, switching between aggressive (argmax) and conservative (sample top-2) decoding by a PU threshold
target_quantity: monetary-policy stance label (hawkish/dovish/neutral) of FOMC text + calibrated prediction confidence
incumbent_beaten: GPT-4.1, Gemini-2.5-pro, DeepSeek-R1, Phi-4, Qwen3, FinBERT, HD-Dissent, AICBC (zero-shot and LoRA-fine-tuned)
novelty_angle: grounds Fedspeak reasoning in explicit monetary-policy transmission paths (ablation shows path removal hurts most) and decomposes LLM uncertainty into cognitive-risk vs environmental-ambiguity, validated as a statistically significant (p<1e-6) error predictor enabling abstention
data_used: findata-native (text): Trillion Dollar Words FOMC dataset (minutes/press-conf/speeches, 1996-2022); needs central-bank text
why_accepted: SOTA on FOMC stance (+6% F1 over GPT-4.1) plus a rigorously tested uncertainty signal (T-test/Mann-Whitney/logistic) supporting human-in-the-loop abstention

title: JaxMARL-HFT: GPU-Accelerated Large-Scale Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for High-Frequency Trading
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 干预X=GPU-accelerated concurrent MARL环境(JAX, market-by-order LOB) → 指标Y=端到端训练速度(↑240x)使大规模LOB MARL可行,学到的执行/做市策略超基线
ai_mechanism: multi-agent RL (independent PPO) on a JAX-vectorized limit-order-book simulator with heterogeneous agent types, market-replay background flow, GRU policies
target_quantity: agent PnL / slippage vs benchmarks; environment throughput (steps/s)
incumbent_beaten: ABIDES-gym, PyMarketSim, CPU-MARL (speed); TWAP and Avellaneda-Stoikov (policy quality)
novelty_angle: First GPU-accelerated fully-concurrent MARL framework for HFT on MBO data; reframes ABM calibration as learnable MARL and unlocks year-scale LOBSTER training
data_used: needs intraday — LOBSTER market-by-order tick data (1yr AMZN, 400M orders); not findata-native
why_accepted: Open-source infrastructure with a dramatic, benchmarked 240x speedup enabling previously-infeasible MARL-for-HFT research; honest about non-profitable MM caveat

title: Quantifying Semantic Shift in Financial NLP: Robust Metrics for Market Prediction Stability
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 干预X=四个诊断指标(causal-attribution/perturbation-sensitivity/semantic-volatility/NLI-consistency)across macro regimes → 指标Y=暴露LSTM/Transformer在regime-shift下的预测可靠性退化(JS散度与误差相关)
ai_mechanism: regime-partitioned diagnostic suite over text encoders (TF-IDF+LSTM, DistilBERT, MiniLM-augmented) with NLI/GPT-4 entailment scoring of prediction-vs-news coherence
target_quantity: next-day stock return prediction error (MSE) and four robustness functionals per regime
has_classical_optimum: no — diagnostic framework, no estimator optimum
incumbent_beaten: none beaten as such — accuracy-only evaluation shown insufficient; LSTM more stable than Transformer under drift
novelty_angle: Regime-aware auditing framework separating situational vs linguistic drift via matched within/cross-regime event controls; multi-axis robustness profile beyond accuracy
data_used: findata-native-ish — FNSPID financial news + Yahoo daily returns, 110 S&P500 across 11 GICS sectors (needs text corpus)
why_accepted: Operationalizes auditability/stress-testing for financial NLP under crises with concrete metrics correlating drift to error; timely regime-robustness angle

title: Graph Learning for Foreign Exchange Rate Prediction and Statistical Arbitrage
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 干预X=两步图学习(spatiotemporal GNN for FX edge-regression + projection/ReLU-constrained stochastic-optimization GNN尊重观测-执行时滞) → 指标Y=FXRP MSE显著改善 & FXSA信息比率+61.89%/Sortino+45.51%,且可证满足套利约束
ai_mechanism: edge-level GNN regression on currency-IR graph + a constraint-projecting GNN that maximizes information ratio while provably enforcing flow/triangular-no-arbitrage constraints under execution-lag stochasticity
target_quantity: FX rate prediction (MSE) and arbitrage trading quantities / risk-adjusted return
incumbent_beaten: VAR/GARCH and non-graph DL for FXRP; prior LP/GNN arbitrage solvers ([25][26][34]) that ignore execution lag and violate constraints
novelty_angle: First to fold observation-execution time lag + FX-rate stochasticity into the arbitrage optimization with provable empirical-arbitrage-constraint satisfaction via projection+ReLU; MLE currency-value node features
data_used: findata-native — daily FX rates + government bond interest rates for 10 most-traded currencies (price+macro)
why_accepted: Closes a look-ahead-bias gap prior FX-arbitrage work overlooked; couples a structurally-grounded GNN with a provable-feasibility decision layer and real-market evaluation

title: Factor-Driven Network Informed Restricted Vector Autoregression (FNIRVAR)
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 干预X=静态因子模型(PCA)+基于未观测SBM网络的限制性VAR对idiosyncratic分量建模 → 指标Y=高维收益/宏观预测MSPE↓ & 交易Sharpe(daily 1.95, intraday 2.20)超因子-only与因子+LASSO
ai_mechanism: two-step estimator: PCA strong-factor extraction (large-eigengap) then spectral-clustering/GMM SBM-block-restricted VAR (NIRVAR) on idiosyncratic residuals via OLS/GLS
target_quantity: one-step-ahead high-dimensional return/IP forecasts; portfolio Sharpe & PnL
incumbent_beaten: static factor model (Fan et al.) and factor+LASSO sparse VAR (Miao et al./Krampe-Margaritella)
novelty_angle: First to combine dense factor model with an unobserved-network sparse VAR (realised, not expected, adjacency) — block-weak-factor interpretation generalizing pairs trading to co-moving groups
data_used: needs CRSP/intraday — CRSP daily (648 assets), LOBSTER 30-min intraday (516 Nasdaq), FRED-MD macro
why_accepted: Principled stat-ME contribution with stationarity proof, eigengap justification, and strong out-of-sample Sharpe on three real datasets incl transaction-cost sensitivity
