title: ClauseLens: Clause-Grounded, CVaR-Constrained Reinforcement Learning for Trustworthy Reinsurance Pricing
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 干预X=检索法律条款嵌入状态+CVaR约束RL(dual-projected PPO)+条款可行性掩码与条款锚定解释 → 指标Y=偿付能力违规↓51%, CVaR0.10↑27.9%, 解释蕴含准确率88.2%
ai_mechanism: Risk-Aware Constrained MDP solved by dual-projected PPO with CVaR-weighted advantage + Lagrangian constraint duals; retrieval-augmented legal-clause state embeddings drive action masking and T5 justification generation
target_quantity: reinsurance treaty quote (quota share/attachment); tail-risk (CVaR), violation rate, explanation fidelity/retrieval P-R
has_classical_optimum: no — simulated CMDP, no closed-form quoting optimum
incumbent_beaten: StaticHeuristic rule-based quoting and Baseline-RL (CVaR PPO without clause retrieval)
novelty_angle: First to embed retrieved statutory clauses into BOTH policy (hard feasibility masks) and explanation pathways within a CVaR-constrained RL loop — bridging tail-risk optimization with auditable regulatory grounding
data_used: needs synthetic/non-findata — Poisson-compound catastrophe loss simulator + 6,600-clause legal corpus (Solvency II/NAIC/IFRS17); not market data
why_accepted: Tackles auditability/compliance for high-stakes regulated pricing with a clean ablation showing retrieval, constraint, justification each add value; aligns with EU AI Act governance agenda

title: Query Generation Pipeline with Enhanced Answerability Assessment for Financial Information Retrieval
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 干预X=LLM单/多文档query生成+reasoning-augmented可回答性评估器 → 指标Y=构建KoBankIR(815查询/204银行文档)揭示现有检索模型在多文档/对比查询上严重失败(NDCG@5降至0.302-0.414)
ai_mechanism: GPT-4o multi-doc query synthesis (topic-merge/context-deepen/compare-contrast) with multi-document-dependency filtering, plus DeepSeek-R1-distilled 'think'-augmented answerability scorer aligned to human judgment
target_quantity: retrieval quality (NDCG/mAP/Recall) on domain queries; evaluator-human correlation (Pearson up to 0.60/0.775)
incumbent_beaten: G-EVAL (GPT-4/4o/o1) answerability evaluators; sparse/dense/multi-vector retrievers (BM25, BGE-M3, e5) shown to struggle
novelty_angle: Reasoning-augmented small-model answerability evaluator beating GPT-4-based G-EVAL; first Korean banking-domain multi-document IR benchmark exposing retriever weakness on comparative reasoning
data_used: needs non-US text — 204 Korean bank product disclosures (proprietary banking docs), not findata-native
why_accepted: New benchmark + evaluation methodology revealing concrete SOTA-retriever failure on realistic multi-hop banking queries; legal-constraint motivation for synthetic queries

title: Time-Varying Factor-Augmented Models for Volatility Forecasting
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 干预X=从已实现波动率直接抽取时变载荷的横截面因子并增广任意预测模型(AR/HAR/MIDAS/LSTM) → 指标Y=OOS R²↑(equity≤12.8%, crypto≤22.8%),pairs-trading把-5.5%年化亏损翻转为+7.3%盈利
ai_mechanism: rolling-window time-varying factor model (top-k eigenvectors of local RV covariance) producing dynamic factors/loadings appended as covariates to statistical and LSTM volatility forecasters
target_quantity: 1-day & 7-day realized-volatility forecasts (R²/MSE/QLIKE); pairs-trading Sharpe & return
incumbent_beaten: static-loading factor-vol models and univariate AR/HAR/MIDAS/LSTM; multivariate GARCH (infeasible at scale)
novelty_angle: First volatility-forecast framework with factors extracted directly from realized volatilities AND time-varying loadings; model-agnostic augmentation with minimal extra parameters, horizon-dependent factor selection
data_used: needs intraday — 5-min high-frequency RV for 5 tech equities (WRDS TAQ) + 5 cryptos (Kaiko); not findata-native
why_accepted: Resolves the static-loading limitation of vol factor models with a parsimonious, model-agnostic boost validated by DM tests and an economically meaningful loss-reversal backtest across two asset classes

title: Learning to Manage Investment Portfolios beyond Simple Utility Functions
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 干预X=条件WGAN-GP学习基金经理策略的潜在表征 p(w_t|X,r,φ,w_{t-1}) 无需指定效用函数 → 指标Y=8维潜空间线性可分Lipper风格(macro-recall 77%)并揭示隐含Markowitz-优化与异质turnover/concentration行为
ai_mechanism: conditional WGAN-GP with Carhart-four-factor VAE market-state generator, three-lane strategy encoder→8-dim latent, decoder allocator, distributional discriminator over portfolio-weighted features
target_quantity: conditional portfolio-weight distribution; reconstruction (count/concentration/turnover), style-classification recall, efficient-frontier proximity
has_classical_optimum: partial — Markowitz-Ledoit-Wolf used as a probe, not solved
incumbent_beaten: Zero-Trade, Turnover-Matched-Random, Factor-Tilt-Matched baselines, and Generator-only ablation (no discriminator)
novelty_angle: GANs repurposed to learn/clone fund-manager strategies from holdings (not synthetic-price generation); utility-free behavioral characterization revealing heterogeneous implicit objectives for ABM populations
data_used: needs CRSP — CRSP Survivor-Bias-Free Mutual Fund holdings (1436 funds, 2010-2024) + Carhart loadings; not findata-native
why_accepted: Audits revealed-preference manager behavior without utility specification, with interpretable latent space and counterfactual strategy-transfer tests showing adversarial training learns transferable principles

title: Mechanistic Interpretability of Large Language Models with Applications to the Financial Services Industry
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: Apply mechanistic-interpretability tooling (direct logit attribution + activation patching) to GPT-2 Small on a fair-lending-violation compliance task X to localize the attention heads/MLP layers Y responsible for the decision
ai_mechanism: transformer circuit discovery via direct logit attribution and causal activation/path patching on clean-vs-corrupted prompt pairs to attribute the Yes/No logit difference to specific heads and MLP layers
target_quantity: per-head/per-layer contribution to the logit difference logit(Yes)-logit(No) on a compliance-classification task
incumbent_beaten: none; no baseline beaten, first application of mech-interp to financial-compliance LLM tasks (IOI-style algorithmic-task framing transferred to fair-lending/UDAAP/TCPA)
novelty_angle: first to design financial-compliance algorithmic tasks (fair lending, UDAAP, TCPA rulesets) and reverse-engineer the GPT-2 circuit that completes them; finds compliance task is far less localized than IOI (logit diff improves across all layers, MLP-2/4 matter, value-vector patching dominates in late layers)
data_used: synthetic hand-crafted compliance prompt templates only; no market data, findata-irrelevant
why_accepted: pioneering positioning (first mech-interp for financial-services LLMs), regulatory-relevance for accountability/bias, concrete head-level findings with established ARENA/IOI methodology

title: GARCH-Informed Neural Networks for Volatility Prediction in Financial Markets
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: Embed GARCH-predicted variance as a regularization term in an LSTM loss (PINN-style) X to improve out-of-sample daily-volatility forecast accuracy Y on global equity indices
ai_mechanism: physics-informed-style hybrid: two-phase model where GARCH(1,1) supplies a soft-label / regularizer in a weighted MSE loss (lambda * MSE(truth) + (1-lambda) * MSE(GARCH)) guarding an LSTM against overfitting on the second moment
target_quantity: next-day conditional variance (squared log-return residual) forecast on a 90-day rolling window
has_classical_optimum: yes — GARCH-HAR is the named optimum and incumbent it leans on
incumbent_beaten: GARCH(1,1), GJR-GARCH, TGARCH, naive LSTM; GINN beats GARCH by ~5.8% avg and beats GJR/TGARCH/LSTM by 18-23% across 21 index/metric cells
novelty_angle: transfers PINN regularization idea to econometric stylized facts as the physical law; surprising GINN-0 (lambda=0, trained only on GARCH output) still beats GARCH; honest discussion that R2/MSE/MAE reward over-smoothing and may be unfit for volatility eval
data_used: 7 global equity indices, daily close from Yahoo Finance 1992-2022; findata-native (price-only, variance constructible)
why_accepted: clean hybrid framing, strong multi-index out-of-sample comparison vs proper GARCH-family baselines, candid limitations (metric critique, GARCH-dependence failure modes on NIK/HSI)

title: Fast Deep Hedging with Second-Order Optimization
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: Precondition deep-hedging policy gradients with a Kronecker-factored generalized-Gauss-Newton curvature matrix X to cut optimization steps Y to ~1/4 of Adam for hedging a cliquet under stochastic volatility
ai_mechanism: second-order optimization (DH-KFAC): builds a GGN-type preconditioner from pathwise-differentiable transition dynamics, approximated block-diagonal + Kronecker-factored (EKFAC/RNN-KFAC) with a new shrinkage-based damping; recurrent action-space (floating grid) parameterization
target_quantity: neural hedging policy minimizing weighted PnL variance + transaction costs for a path-dependent (cliquet) option in Heston model
has_classical_optimum: partial — Almgren-Chriss/Black-Scholes-SABR give frictionless hedges but exotic+frictions has no closed form
incumbent_beaten: Adam (diagonal adaptive moment); DH-KFAC reaches target validation loss in ~25% of Adam's steps with lower wall-clock for small nets
novelty_angle: first second-order scheme tailored to deep hedging; recognizes hedging loss is non-separable over time (terminal-only credit assignment) and ill-conditioned, motivating curvature beyond FIM (which is inapplicable since actions are deterministic); floating-grid action space with recurrence to internalize option portfolio state
data_used: simulated Heston paths (700k) pricing 19 vanilla options per step; needs option pricing / stochastic-vol simulator, not findata-native (synthetic options market)
why_accepted: novel composition of KFAC/EKFAC/RNN-KFAC + new damping for a hard practical problem, clear 4x speedup, interpretable learned hedge (uses options for tail protection), J.P. Morgan industrial relevance

title: A Dutch Financial Large Language Model (FinGEITje)
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: Instruction-tune a Dutch base LLM on 140k auto-translated financial samples X to raise Dutch financial NLP task accuracy Y across 5 tasks (SA/NER/HC/RE/QA)
ai_mechanism: QLoRA instruction fine-tuning on Mistral-7B/GEITje backbone using an automated GPT-3.5 translation+dedup+language-filter pipeline; LLM-as-independent-evaluator for answer extraction and scoring
target_quantity: F1/accuracy on five Dutch (and English) financial NLP tasks via a new benchmark
incumbent_beaten: general Dutch LLMs (GEITje-ultra/-sft), English finance LLMs FinMA & FinGPT, and gpt-3.5-turbo; FinGEITje best on all 5 Dutch tasks
novelty_angle: first Dutch financial LLM + first Dutch financial benchmark + reusable language-agnostic instruction-dataset translation method; LLM-evaluator to scale grading; surprising cross-lingual competence on English tasks
data_used: translated open financial NLP datasets (FPB, FiQA, TFNS, FinRED, ConvFinQA, etc); text-only, not market findata
why_accepted: fills clear non-English gap, full open-source release (data+model+benchmark+eval), strong multi-model comparison, careful ethics/translationese discussion

title: Can GANs Learn the Stylized Facts of Financial Time Series?
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: Audit whether vanilla GANs with varied generator architectures X can reproduce named stylized facts Y (random walk, mean reversion, jumps, vol-of-vol, cross-asset dependence) of synthetic financial series
ai_mechanism: adversarial generative modeling with 5 generator architectures (MLP, MLP-CNN, LSTM, GRU, TCN); JS-divergence/KL-based objective for hyperparameter search over return + final-value (+ bivariate) distributions
target_quantity: fidelity of generated paths to each stochastic process's stylized facts (reverting speed/count, jump size/count, vol-of-vol moments, correlation) measured by Jensen-Shannon divergence
has_classical_optimum: yes — the data-generating processes themselves (BM/GBM/OU/Jump-Diffusion/Heston) are the optimum the GAN tries to match
incumbent_beaten: none beaten; diagnostic study showing GANs match BM/GBM well but fail OU reverting speed (esp. TCN), Jump-Diffusion return distribution worst, vol-of-vol degrades as it rises, and multivariate dependency collapses to one variable
novelty_angle: uses controllable synthetic stochastic processes as ground-truth probes (rather than messy real data) to isolate which stylized fact each generator architecture can/cannot learn; reframes 'GANs match the return distribution' as insufficient for simulator use, reveals architecture-dependent failures
data_used: synthetic simulated processes (BM/GBM/OU/JD/Heston) at lengths 25/50/100; price-only constructible, findata-adjacent but synthetic
why_accepted: benchmark-style negative-result clarity (naive GANs fail intricate temporal structure), systematic architecture x process x length sweep, cautionary message for synthetic-data backtesting

title: GLinSAT: The General Linear Satisfiability Neural Network Layer By Accelerated Gradient Descent
venue: Neural Information Processing Systems
one_liner: Project neural-net outputs onto general (signed) linear + bounded constraints via an entropy-regularized-LP differentiable layer X to enforce hard constraints Y (e.g. portfolio sum/floor) while staying GPU-parallel and matrix-factorization-free
ai_mechanism: reformulate output projection as entropy-regularized LP; via duality becomes unconstrained convex problem with Lipschitz gradient solved by accelerated gradient descent (APDAGD) with shrinkage damping; both autodiff and implicit-differentiation backward passes; no matrix factorization
target_quantity: constraint-feasible projection of network outputs (decision variables) under general linear constraints across four tasks incl. predictive portfolio allocation
has_classical_optimum: partial — projection is convex (entropy-reg LP has unique optimum) but the full decision-focused objective is not
incumbent_beaten: LinSAT (positive-linear only), CvxpyLayers, OptNet; GLinSAT faster, lower memory, higher Sharpe (2.535/2.608 vs LinSAT 2.245/2.409), 100% TSP feasibility, higher graph-matching F1
novelty_angle: first general (signed-coefficient) linear satisfiability layer that is fully differentiable AND matrix-factorization-free; the complementary logistic-entropy regularization on both x/u and 1-x/u is the key trick enabling a closed-form sigmoid dual; portfolio is one of four showcase domains
data_used: predictive portfolio allocation dataset (from LinSAT) + TSP/graph-matching/power-system; portfolio is generic price-derived, not deep findata; finance is a demo not focus
why_accepted: NeurIPS: clear method gap (LinSAT's positivity restriction), rigorous convex reformulation + duality + complexity bound, broad multi-domain wins, open-source

title: A Globally Optimal Portfolio for m-Sparse Sharpe Ratio Maximization
venue: Neural Information Processing Systems
one_liner: Recast m-sparse (L0-constrained) Sharpe-ratio maximization as equivalent sparse quadratic programming X and solve via a proximal gradient algorithm with KL-property convergence guarantees Y to a globally optimal sparse portfolio
ai_mechanism: convert fractional (Sharpe) optimization to equivalent quadratic program under simplex + L0 constraint; exploit semi-algebraic objective + Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz property to prove a Proximal Gradient Algorithm converges (with rates O(1/sqrt k)) to global/local optimum; closed-form proximity operator (top-m projection)
target_quantity: portfolio weights maximizing the original Sharpe ratio (excess return / sqrt risk) under exactly <=m active assets, long-only, self-financing
has_classical_optimum: yes — Markowitz-Ledoit-Wolf / Sharpe mean-variance is the named optimum being sparsified
incumbent_beaten: 1/N, IPSRM-D, PLCT, SSMP, MAXER, SSPO, SPOLC, S1/S2/S3; mSSRM-PGA beats all incl. 1/N on out-of-sample Sharpe (6/6 at T=60) and cumulative wealth (4/6 best, else 2nd)
novelty_angle: first method to directly optimize the true (unmodified) Sharpe ratio under the exact L0 cardinality constraint with a theoretically-sound global-optimality guarantee; fractional->quadratic equivalence (Theorem 1) + KL-based convergence; no external solver, little tuning, sparsity robust to choice of m
data_used: 6 Fama-French real benchmark datasets (FF25/FF25EU/FF32/FF49/FF100/FF100MEINV), monthly; FF-factor data is findata-native (constructible)
why_accepted: NeurIPS optimization-theory contribution: novel nonconvex reformulation, rigorous KL convergence proofs with rates, strong real-data out-of-sample portfolio results and exact sparsity control

title: Automated Efficient Estimation using Monte Carlo Efficient Influence Functions (MC-EIF)
venue: Neural Information Processing Systems
one_liner: Automate efficient-influence-function computation via Monte Carlo (gradient x inverse-Fisher x score) X to enable plug-in-corrected sqrt-N-efficient estimation Y for arbitrary functionals incl. minimum-variance portfolio weights
ai_mechanism: express the EIF in parametric models as [grad psi]^T I^{-1} grad log p; approximate Fisher-vector products with Pearlmutter's trick + conjugate gradient (factorization-free) inside differentiable PPL (Pyro/ChiRho); drop into one-step / DML / TMLE estimator templates
target_quantity: low-dimensional estimands (ATE, expected density, and Markowitz/global-minimum-variance optimal portfolio weights) with high-dimensional nuisance (covariance) parameters
has_classical_optimum: yes — Markowitz-Ledoit-Wolf min-variance portfolio is the named target; semiparametric EIF is the efficiency optimum
incumbent_beaten: analytic-EIF estimators (at parity, with consistency + optimal sqrt-N rate proven) and the empirical-Gateaux finite-difference baseline (Jordan 2022, which is unstable for p>2); plug-in beaten on portfolio REV/RMSE
novelty_angle: fully automated EIF via existing autodiff/PPL primitives with non-asymptotic error bound (M ~ p log p); capstone delivers the first efficient estimator for the global-minimum-variance portfolio functional, treating the DxD covariance as a high-dim nuisance and the weights as the low-dim target
data_used: simulated multivariate-Gaussian asset returns (D=25, N=1000, LKJ-sampled covariance); synthetic, not real findata but price-return-native structure
why_accepted: NeurIPS: turns expert-only semiparametric derivations into push-button computation, proves consistency + optimal rates + error bound, validates parity with analytic EIFs, novel portfolio capstone

title: DCC: Differentiable Cardinality Constraints for Partial Index Tracking
venue: AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
one_liner: 干预X=用sigmoid/rational可微近似替代l0-cardinality约束并入SLSQP → 指标Y=部分复制index tracking error(MAE)降低且多项式时间
ai_mechanism: differentiable relaxation of an l0/cardinality count via sigmoid surrogate with floating-point-precision-bounded temperature constant, plugged into Lagrangian/SLSQP optimization
target_quantity: portfolio weight vector under a hard cardinality (≤K stocks) constraint minimizing index tracking error
incumbent_beaten: stochastic neural network (SNN, SOTA heuristic), forward/backward selection; DCC_fpp lower MAE (e.g. 2.39 vs SNN 4.90 at K=30) and faster

title: Autoregressive Policy Optimization for Constrained Allocation Tasks
venue: Neural Information Processing Systems
one_liner: 干预X=用autoregressive逐资产采样+LP可行区间+de-biasing的策略代替soft-constraint CRL → 指标Y=portfolio/allocation回报↑且硬约束零违反

title: FinDiff: Diffusion Models for Financial Tabular Data Generation

ai_mechanism: contrastive representation learning regularized by a physics-informed neural net enforcing Ornstein-Uhlenbeck dynamics in learned clusters
target_quantity: tradable mean-reverting asset clusters / spread stationarity
incumbent_beaten: cointegration/distance-based pairs-clustering benchmarks on NYSE
novelty_angle: embeds OU stationarity as a PINN regularizer on the embedding so clusters are intrinsically tradable, not merely similar
data_used: findata-native (NYSE daily prices)
why_accepted: couples a named stochastic-process prior with deep clustering and shows a simple static-threshold strategy beats benchmark clusters

title: Evaluating the Ethical Judgment of Large Language Models in Financial Market Abuse Cases
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 在1971个市场操纵情景上系统改变激励/措辞(X)→量化LLM批准可疑交易的敏感度与误判(Y)
ai_mechanism: factorial Taguchi-L27 scenario perturbation benchmark probing LLM decision policies under varied incentive/framing factors
target_quantity: approval rate of suspicious trades / misclassification under incentive shifts
incumbent_beaten: none (audit benchmark across 10 LLMs, no method-beating claim)
novelty_angle: DOE-style factorial design over real enforcement cases isolates which contextual factors (profit, obfuscation, compliant framing) flip ethical judgment
data_used: needs non-findata (73 anonymized regulatory enforcement cases + text)
why_accepted: structured, reproducible safety benchmark grounded in real market-abuse law for high-stakes deployment

title: Market Selection with Midpoint Matching: A Strategic Agent-Based Analysis
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 在agent模拟中改变M-ELO持有期(X)→分析venue选择的Nash均衡、福利与对掠夺性交易的筛选(Y)
ai_mechanism: empirical game-theoretic analysis (EGTA) over agent-based market simulation enumerating pure/mixed Nash equilibria across holding periods
target_quantity: equilibrium venue choice, welfare, adverse-selection screening
incumbent_beaten: none (mechanism-design analysis, not a predictor)
novelty_angle: uses EGTA on a calibrated LOB+M-ELO simulator to expose the holding-period trade-off between deterring predatory HFT and preserving midpoint premium
data_used: needs intraday (simulated LOB microstructure, Nasdaq M-ELO mechanism)
why_accepted: rigorous game-theoretic treatment of a real exchange mechanism with policy-relevant welfare findings

title: Probability-Density-Consistent Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Stochastic Local Volatility Model Calibration
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 把Fokker-Planck方程与风险中性密度约束嵌入PINN(X)→无套利地校准SLV隐含波动面且减半算力(Y)
ai_mechanism: physics-informed neural network embedding forward Kolmogorov-Fokker-Planck PDE and risk-neutral density constraints with self-adaptive bilevel loss balancing
target_quantity: calibrated stochastic-local-volatility surface consistent with no static/dynamic arbitrage
incumbent_beaten: conventional SLV calibrators (matches/exceeds accuracy, halves runtime)
novelty_angle: joint density + FPE constraint guarantees arbitrage-free surfaces while a gradient-rescaling bilevel optimizer stabilizes the ill-posed inverse problem
data_used: needs options (FX implied-vol surfaces) + synthetic
why_accepted: solves an ill-posed inverse problem with provable no-arbitrage guarantees and a real-data speedup over incumbent calibrators

title: Language Models for Automated Market Commentary from Corporate Disclosures
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 把专家评论与对应公司披露对齐成基准(X)→评估9个LLM生成金融评论的对齐度与事实一致性(Y)
ai_mechanism: alignment methodology pairing expert commentary with source disclosures to enable reference-based evaluation of LLM-generated financial text
target_quantity: linguistic quality, content alignment, factual consistency of generated commentary
incumbent_beaten: GPT-4o (Llama-4-Scout surpasses on alignment)
novelty_angle: builds an expert-disclosure alignment protocol for non-US (Brazilian) market and shows open models can rival proprietary ones on factual alignment
data_used: needs non-US + restatement (Brazilian disclosures + expert commentary text)
why_accepted: fills an understudied evaluation gap for grounded financial-text generation with a reproducible alignment benchmark and open-model finding

title: Fast Monitoring of Systemic Risk in Financial Networks with Credit Default Swaps
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 用计算清算法(+CNN代理)处理含CDS的金融网络(X)→在硬度障碍下快速求解系统性风险/违约传染(Y)
ai_mechanism: computational clearing algorithm for CDS-laden financial networks with optional CNN surrogate for instantaneous approximate solutions
target_quantity: cleared payment vector / contagion exposure under central clearing
incumbent_beaten: computational-hardness baselines (clears large networks fast despite NP barriers)
novelty_angle: empirically circumvents known hardness for CDS clearing and tackles default-ambiguity selection via objective-driven solutions
data_used: needs non-findata (interbank CDS network structure)
why_accepted: positive empirical answer against theoretical hardness, plus a default-ambiguity resolution mechanism

title: Attention-Based Multi-Asset Order Flow Networks for Enhanced Mid-Price Prediction
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 用多轴注意力跨资产建模Granger-筛选的OFI(X)→提升110只Nasdaq股的mid-price预测R²(Y)
ai_mechanism: Transformer with multi-axis attention over time/assets/book-levels on order-flow-imbalance features, peers selected by rolling Granger-causality
target_quantity: short-horizon mid-price movement (R²)
incumbent_beaten: DeepLOB, BINCTABL, TLOB and single-asset baseline (R² gains in >90% cases)
novelty_angle: statistically-validated cross-asset OFI dependencies via Granger gating feeding a multi-axis attention model, beating single-asset SOTA
data_used: needs intraday (multi-asset Nasdaq LOB/OFI)
why_accepted: clear SOTA beat on 110 assets with ablations isolating cross-asset vs temporal vs level contributions

title: Linking Industry Sectors and Financial Statements: A Hybrid Approach for Company Classification
venue: AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
one_liner: 对财报同时用数值+文本表征喂语言模型(X)→在SIC行业分类上匹配决策树并提升可解释性(Y)
ai_mechanism: language-model encoding of textual fields in financial statements combined with numeric features for supervised sector classification
target_quantity: SIC industry-sector label of a company
incumbent_beaten: decision-tree classifiers using numeric-only financial records (matched, more explainable)
novelty_angle: shows textual content in accounting filings carries sector signal that LMs exploit to match numeric-only trees with better explainability
data_used: findata-native (financial statements + SIC codes)
why_accepted: demonstrates an underused text modality in filings and frames it as groundwork for semi-automatic auditing

title: LatentGraph: From Latent States to Rule-based Expressions for Explainable Financial Forecasting
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 把潜因子经特征图+二值化喂Tsetlin机生成if-then规则(X)→在保持竞争性召回下端到端可解释分类(Y)

target_quantity: binary risk/churn classification with traceable rule explanations
incumbent_beaten: classical baselines (highest recall 0.7096, near-parity accuracy)
novelty_angle: fully traceable pipeline where every stage logs thresholds/profiles so each decision maps back to concrete coordinates without extra tooling
data_used: needs non-findata (Telco Customer Churn dataset, not financial)
why_accepted: explainability-first architecture delivering competitive recall with clause-level audit trail

title: Shock-Biased Attention: Enhancing Transformer Hawkes Processes with Amplitude-Driven Temporal Kernels
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 把事件mark(如成交量)与时间衰减直接注入注意力矩阵偏置(X)→提升Transformer-Hawkes的事件预测与可解释性(Y)

data_used: needs intraday (financial event/transaction sequences with volume marks)
why_accepted: principled fusion of marked-point-process theory with attention, outperforming post-attention baselines with interpretable parameters

title: Constrained Tabular Diffusion for Finance
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 在反向扩散采样环里插入免训练可行性算子(X)→零约束违反地生成合规金融合成表数据(Y)

data_used: findata-native (large-scale financial tabular datasets)
why_accepted: addresses a hard regulatory requirement (provable feasibility) that vanilla generative models cannot meet, with broad utility gains

venue: AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

why_accepted: compact student-abstract result showing GAF-based domain matching consistently cuts prediction error across architectures

title: MacroVAE: Counterfactual Financial Scenario Generation via Macroeconomic Conditioning
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance
one_liner: 用宏观指标条件化的VAE(FiLM调制)生成收益序列(X)→对未观测宏观情景做反事实压力测试(Y)
ai_mechanism: conditional VAE with convolutional ResNet blocks and Feature-wise Linear Modulation conditioning return generation on macroeconomic indicators
target_quantity: counterfactual return-sequence distributions under specified macro scenarios
incumbent_beaten: SOTA generative baselines (distribution replication, stylized facts)
novelty_angle: FiLM macro-conditioning lets the model extrapolate to rare/unobserved inflation-growth regimes for forward-looking stress testing
data_used: findata-native (global futures returns + macro indicators)
why_accepted: enables counterfactual stress scenarios beyond history while preserving stylized facts, beating generative baselines out-of-sample

title: Adaptive Quantum Channels as Long-Memory Generative Models

target_quantity: marginal+joint distribution of mid-price movements and volatility regimes

data_used: needs intraday (limit order book mid-price)
why_accepted: novel quantum-channel generative formalism with quantified temporal inductive bias reproducing complex HFT dependencies

title: Constraint-aware Pareto Optimization for Tree-Structured Networks: Addressing Decarbonization Targets with Hydropower Expansion
venue: AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

ai_mechanism: constraint-aware exact/approximate Pareto-frontier optimization on tree-structured networks incorporating objective lower/upper bounds
target_quantity: constrained Pareto frontier of energy-vs-socioenvironmental trade-offs

why_accepted: fills a real-world feasibility gap in tree-network Pareto optimization with policy-relevant decarbonization application

title: Adaptive Sample Weighting with Regime-Aware Meta-Learning Framework for Financial Forecasting
venue: International Conference on AI in Finance

target_quantity: portfolio weights maximizing out-of-sample return and Sharpe

data_used: findata-native (multi-asset equity returns)
why_accepted: decision-aware E2E allocation beating both classical tangency and deep baselines net of costs

venue: AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

target_quantity: stock movement / investment ranking prediction
incumbent_beaten: SOTA stock-investment methods on public datasets

why_accepted: captures multifaceted and time-varying inter-stock relations missing from prior graph/sequential models, achieving best public-dataset performance
